v: Ha winhaj Salomón yuninal winhaj David, ix tek'k'aj wal yopisio winh, yujto a Jehová sDiosal winh ayoch yet'ok, ix te k'echa'anh winh t'a yopisio chi'.
Ix yawtan masanil heb' yetisraelal winh: Haton heb' niwak yajalil heb' soldado, heb' juez, heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok.

Ix b'at winh yet' masanil heb' ix smolb'ej sb'a chi' t'a jun lugar cha'anh t'a Gabaón, yujto hata' aykan kajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, haton jun sb'onakkan winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios t'a tzinan lu'um.
Palta a winhaj rey David ik'jinakkot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová t'a Quiriat-jearim, yak'annakoch winh t'a yol jun mantiado b'ob'il yuj t'a Jerusalén.

Haxo pax jun altar nab'a bronce b'ob'il yuj winhaj Bezaleel yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchikin winhaj Hur, ha t'a Gabaón chi' aykani, t'a yichanh skajnub' Jehová. Ix b'at winhaj rey Salomón chi' yet' masanil heb' anima chi' ta', yik b'at sk'anb'ej sb'a heb' t'a Dios.

Ix k'ek'och winh t'a yichanh Jehová, b'aj ay jun altar bronce chi', haton t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ix schekan winh nhusjoktz'a mil nok' silab' t'a Jehová t'a yib'anh jun altar chi'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan icha tik: k'an t'ayin tas tza nib'ej, ol wak' t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a Dios chi' icha tik: Ha ach tik Mamin, ix ak' wal a wach'k'olal t'a winhaj David in mam. Ha inxo ix in ak'och reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha tikne'ik ach Jehová Dios, elokab'k'och tas ix al t'a winh in mam chi', yujto ix in ak'och reyal t'a jun a chonhab' manh jantakok sb'isul tik, icha spokokal lum lum.
Yuj chi', ak' in jelanil, tzak'an wojtakej tas swutej in kuchb'an jun chonhab' tik. Yujto malaj junok mach syal yak'an yajalil t'a jun a chonhab' tik t'a yol yiko', xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Dios t'a winh icha tik: Yujto a jun tik ix jawi t'a a pensar a k'anani, manhok a b'eyumal, ma sniwanil elk'ochi, ma schamel heb' ajk'o'ol, mato snajatb'i a k 'inal, manhok chi' ix a k'ana', palta ha' a jelanil ix a k'ana' yet' aj pensaril yik ol yal ak'an reyal t'a in chonhab' b'aj ach wak'och reyal tik,

yuj chi', ol wak' a jelanil yet' aj pensaril chi'. Ol wak'anpax a b'eyumal yet' sniwanil elk'ochi. Malaj junok rey jelan ek'nakxo icha ach tik, manhxa pax junokxo icha ach tik olto ochok, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix emixta winh t'a Gabaón b'aj ay skajnub' Dios chi', ix jax winh t'a Jerusalén, ix yak'an reyal winh t'a Israel chi'.
Ix smolb'an mil 400 carruaje yik owal winhaj rey Salomón chi' yet' 12 mil nok' chej skuchan heb' soldado. Ix yak'ankan juntzanh chi' winh t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Manhxo jantakok k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro ix smolb'ej winh t'a Jerusalén chi', ichaxonhej k'e'en komon k'e'en ix aj k'e'en. Ha te' k'ute', toxonhej icha te' kaltakte'al higo t'a spanhanil yichtak lum witz ix aj te'.
Ha nok' schej winh rey chi', ix manchajkot nok' t'a Muzri yet' t'a Cilicia. Ha heb' winh smanwajum winh rey chi' smanankot nok' ta'.

Ha junjun carruaje kotnak t'a Egipto chi', 600 siclo plata stojol, haxo junjun nok' chej chi', 150 siclo plata stojol nok'. Haxo masanil heb' winh sreyal heb' heteo yet' heb' sirio, a heb' winh smananxi t'a heb' schonhwajum winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ix sna'an winhaj Salomón sb'ok'e spalacio yet' pax kajnub' b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová.
Yuj chi', ix sik'el 70 mil heb' kuchum ikatz winh yet' 80 mil heb' tzeyum k'e'en t'a jolomtak witz yet' 3 mil 600 heb' tz'ilan munlajel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanb'at winh t'a winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro icha tik: ¿Tzam ak'kot te' k'ute' t'ayin icha ix a k'ulej yet' winh in mam ayik ix sb'o'ank'e spalacio winh b'aj kajnajnak?

Ha tikne'ik ol in b'ok'e jun templo b'aj ol onh och ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, yiknhej ol ajok. Hata' ol nhuschajtz'a incienso suk'uk'i sjab' yuj kik'ancha'anh Jehová chi'. Ol empax tzolan ixim pan t'a yichanh. Ol nhusjok pax tz'a silab' t'a k'inhib'alil, t'a yemk'uhalil yet' pax t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, t'a yik tz'alji k'e'en uj yet' t'a juntzanhxo k'inh tz'och yuj kik'ancha'anh Jehová ko Diosal icha syal scheknab'il ak'b'ilkan t'ayonh israel onh tik, yik sko k'anab'ajej t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha jun templo ol in b'o chi', te niwan ol ajok, yujto a ko Diosal chi', yelxo ek'al sniwanil yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil juntzanh komon Dios.

Palta jun, ¿tom ay junok mach ol yal sb'o'ank'e jun templo chi'? Inatax satcha'anh niwan, palta max yab'laj b'aj tz'aj Dios chi'. ¿Tas waj a in tik, yuj chi' ol in b'ok'e jun templo b'aj syal skajnaj Jehová chi'? Anhej am junok lugar b'aj snhuschajtz'a incienso t'a yichanh syal in b'o'ani.

Yuj chi' ak'kot junok winh winak yojtak wal smunlaj t'a k'e'en oro, t'a k'e'en plata, t'a k'e'en bronce yet' t'a k'e'en hierro yet' t'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak yet' chakchak, to syalpax sb'o'anoch yechel yalnhej tastak winh. Ha winh ol kolwaj yet' heb' k'ayb'ab'il t'a juntzanh chi' ay t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik, haton heb' ix sik'chajkanoch yuj winh in mam.

Hanhejtona' tzak'anpaxkot te te' ay t'a Líbano t'ayin, haton te' k'ute', te' tzikap yet' te' sándalo, yujto wojtak to a heb' a munlajwum, te jelan heb' t'a ch'akoj te' t'a Líbano chi'. Haxo heb' in munlajwum tik, ol kolwaj heb' yet' heb' ik chi',
yik niwan te' syak'el heb', yujto a jun templo ol in b'ok'e chi' te niwan ol ajok, satub'tak pax ol aj yilji.

Ol wak'b'at swa'el heb' a munlajwum chi'. Ol wak'b'at 60 mil quintalok ixim trigo, hanheja' icha chi' pax ixim cebada. Ol wak'paxb'at 110 mil galónok wino, icha pax chi' aceite, xchib'at winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankot jun ch'anh carta winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro chi' t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi' b'aj syal winh icha tik: Ach rey Salomón, a Jehová ix ach ak'anoch reyal t'a Israel chi', yujto te xajan schonhab' chi' yuj.

Yuj chi', alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he Diosal, haton b'o'annak satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik, yujto ach yak'och reyal sk'exulok winhaj rey David a mam. Te nhikan ach, te k'ayb'ab'il ach t'a jelanil, a ach ol a b'ok'e jun stemplo Jehová chi' yet' a palacio b'aj ol ach ajok.
Ha tikne'ik swak'b'at jun winh winak te jelan spensar, te yojtak pax winh, haton winhaj Hiram-abi.

Ha jun winh tik, yune' winh jun ix ix yinhtilal Dan, haxo winh smam winh, aj chonhab' Tiro winh. Ha jun winh tik, yojtak wal winh smunlaj t'a k'e'en oro, t'a k'e'en plata, t'a k'e'en bronce, t'a k'e'en hierro yet' t'a k'e'en k'e'en. Syal pax smunlaj winh t'a te te', t'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak yet' t'a anh chakchak ch'al yet' t'a anh lino. Te jelan winh sb'o'anoch yechel yalnhej tastak. Syal sna'anel winh tas tz'aj junok munlajel, yalnhej tas sk'anchaj t'ay. Ol munlaj winh yet' heb' a munlajwum jelan, haton heb' smunlajtaxon yet' winh a mam, winh te xajan wu'uj.
Yuj chi' swala': Ak'kot ixim trigo chi' t'ayonh, ixim cebada, aceite yet' wino ix ala' to ol ak' chi'.

Yakb'an chi', a onh tik ol kak'el te te' t'a Líbano tik. Jantak te' ol a k'ana', junnhej ol kutej te', ol kik'anb'at te' t'a yib'anh ha' mar, masanto ol k'och te' t'a Jope. Haxo heb' a munlajwum ol ik'anb'at te' t'a Jerusalén, xchikot winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ancha'anh sb'isul masanil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a chonhab' Israel winhaj Salomón chi', ch'ok pax b'ischajnak heb' yuj winhaj rey David. Ha sb'isul heb', 153 mil 600 t'a smasanil.
Ix ak'ji'och 70 mil heb' kuchoj ikatz, 80 mil pax heb' ix och tzeyoj k'e'en t'a tzalkixtak, haxo 3 mil 600 xo heb' ix och yil heb' smunlaj chi'.

Ix scha'el yich winhaj Salomón sb'o'ank'e stemplo Jehová t'a Jerusalén, haton t'a spanhanil sjolom lum tzalan Moriah, b'aj ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winhaj David smam winhaj Salomón chi'. Ha jun lu'um chi' stek'lab' trigo winhaj Ornán aj Jebús, manb'ilkan lum yuj winhaj David chi' yikok stemplo Dios.
Ix scha'el yich munlajel chi' t'a schab'il k'uhal yoch schab'il uj, ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Salomón chi' reyal.
Ha yechel yich templo ix schek winhaj Salomón ak'chajemok, haton tik: 27 metro sk'atul, 9 metro yol schikin.
Haxo pax scorredoral, 9 metro paxi, lajan yet' yol schikin chi'. Haxo scha'anhil, 9 metro paxi. Ix ak'ji'och k'e'en oro t'a sattak scorredoral chi'.

Ix ak'ji'och te chemte' t'a sattak yol templo chi', haton te' tzikap. Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'ji'och k'e'en oro te wach' t'a sattak te' yet' t'a yechel yoch'b'iloch t'a te', haton yechel te' palma yet' yechel k'e'en cadena.
Ix och k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji yelwanub'ok templo chi'. Ha k'e'en oro ix sk'an heb' chi', haton k'e'en skot t'a Parvaim.
Ix ak'ji'och k'e'en oro t'a sattak te' chemte' t'a yo'ol chi' smasanil yet' t'a spatzab'il yet' t'a smarco'al puerta yet' t'a spuerta'il chi'. Ix och pax yechel querubín t'a sattak te' chemte' chi'.

Ix schekan winh makchaj jun cuarto t'a yol templo chi', haton jun cuarto Yiknhej Jehová Yaji. 9 metro ix ajkan chab' spak'ultak jun cuarto chi'. Lajan yet' yol schikin templo chi', 9 metro pax ix aj chab'xo spak'ultak. Ix ak'jipaxoch oro te wach' t'a sattak yo'ol chi'. 500 quintal k'e'en oro ix och t'a sattak yo'ol chi'.
Ha k'e'en lawux ix och t'a yo'ol chi', 20 onza k'e'en oro ix och t'a k'e'en. Ix och pax k'e'en oro t'a sattak yol juntzanh cuarto ay t'a cha'anh.
Ha t'a yol jun cuarto Yiknhej Dios yaj chi', ix schek b'ojok chab' te' yechel querubín winhaj Salomón chi', ix ak'ji'och k'e'en oro t'a spatiktak.

Ha slewanil yajel sk'axil chab' yechel querubín chi', 9 metro, jenhanel sk'axil junjun. Chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro junjun sk'axil chi'. Sk'och jenhan jun sk'axil junjun yechel chi' t'a spak'ultak yol cuarto chi', haxo junjunxo sk'axil, schalaj sb'a t'a snanhal. Ha juntzanh yechel querubín chi', linhjab' elta, k'eljab' elta t'a snanhal yol templo chi'.
Ix schekpax b'ochaj jun k'apak cortina nab'a lino winh, ix och yechel querubín t'ay yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak yet' anh chakchak ch'al.

Ix schekanpax winhaj Salomón chi' b'ojok chab' niwak oy nab'a bronce, 16 metro ix aj ste'el junjun, ix och t'a sat templo chi'. Haxo jun ayk'e t'a schon junjun oy chi', 2 metro yet' 25 centímetro spimal.
Ix b'o pax k'e'en cadena, icha chimpa ix aji, ix och k'e'en t'a spatiktak schon oy chi'. Ix b'o pax 100 yechel te' granada, ix och t'a k'e'en cadena chi'.
Ix ak'ji'och juntzanh niwak oy chi' t'a sat templo chi', jun t'a stojolal sur, junxo t'a stojolal norte. Ha jun t'a sur chi', Jaquín ix sb'i'ej, haxo jun t'a norte chi', Boaz ix sb'i'ej.
Ix schekpax winhaj Salomón chi' b'ojok jun altar nab'a bronce, 9 metro ix aj sk'atul, 9 metro ix aj sat, nanhal yo'il metro ix ajk'e scha'anhil.

Ix b'ochaj pax jun niwan pila yet'tal ha ha' nab'a bronce, setansetan ix aji, nanhal yo'il metro ix aj slewanil sat, 2 metro yet' 25 centímetro ix ajk'e ste'el stitak, haxo jantak ix aj setan chi', 13 metro yet' nanhalxo.
Ha t'a yalanh sti' t'a spatiktak jun pila chi', ayek' cha tzol yechel nok' toro yelwanub'ok. Lajunhe' ayoch t'a junjun 45 centímetro, yaman yaj yet' jun pila chi'.

Ay pax lajchawe' yechel niwak toro nab'a bronce ayoch sb'akhnub'ok yalanh jun pila chi'. Ha juntzanh chi', oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal norte, oxe' pax t'a sur, oxe' pax t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' oxe' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Ha yok juntzanh yechel wakax chi' t'a spatik, ha' ayoch t'a yalanh jun pila chi'. Haxo t'a yib'anh b'akhanemi.
Ha jun pila chi', 8 centímetro spimal. Pech'anel sti' icha xumakil anh chochol. 15 mil galón ha ha' sb'at t'a yo'ol.

Ix b'o pax lajunhe' yunetak pila nab'a bronce b'aj sjuk'chaj masanil tas sk'anchaji ayik snhuschaj silab'. Oye' ix kan t'a stojolal sur, oyexo t'a stojolal norte. Haxo t'a jun niwan pila chi' sb'ik sb'a heb' winh sacerdote.
Ix b'o pax lajunhe' b'akhnub' candil nab'a oro, icha ix aj yalan Dios. Ix ak'chajoch t'a yol templo chi', oye' t'a stojolal sur, oye' t'a stojolal norte.
Ix b'o pax lajunhe' mexa, ix ak'chajoch t'a yol templo chi', oye' t'a stojolal sur, oye' pax t'a stojolal norte. Ix b'o pax 100 niwak uk'ab' nab'a oro.
Ix b'o pax jun amak' yik heb' sacerdote yet' junxo amak' niwakil yik masanil anima. Ix och k'e'en bronce t'a spatiktak jun puerta ay t'a skal chab' amak' chi'.
Ha jun niwan pila ix b'o chi', ha t'a stojolal sur t'a schikin templo chi' ix kani, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ix sb'opax juntzanh k'e'en chen winhaj Hiram chi', k'e'en pala yet' k'e'en niwak uk'ab', icha chi' ix aj sb'o'elk'och munlajel t'a stemplo Dios ix schek b'ojok winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ha juntzanh munlajel ix laj b'o chi': Haton chab' niwak oy, chab' sjolom oy chi' ayk'e'i, setansetan yaji, ayoch k'e'en cadena t'a spatiktak.
Ix och 400 yechel te' granada t'a k'e'en cadena chi', cha tzol ix ajoch t'a junjun k'e'en.
Ay pax lajunhe' yunetak pila, lajunhe' sb'akhnub' yich ayoch t'a yalanh,
jun niwan pila yik ha ha', 12 yechel toro ayoch t'a yalanh,
k'e'en k'e'en chen, k'e'en pala yet' k'e'en tenedor. Masanil juntzanh yamk'ab' ix sb'o winhaj Hiram chi' yuj winhaj Salomón, yik stemplo Jehová yaji, a k'e'en bronce te kopopi ix och t'ay.
Ha juntzanh yamk'ab' nab'a bronce ix b'o chi', ha t'a yol lum b'ak'ech lu'um t'a sti' ha' Jordán ix b'o'i, t'a snanhal Sucot yet' Saretán.
Yujto te niwan juntzanh yamk'ab' nab'a bronce ix schek winhaj Salomón chi' b'ojok, maxtzak echtaj jantak k'e'en bronce ix och t'ay.
Ix schekanpax winhaj Salomón chi' b'ojok juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik stemplo Dios chi', nab'a oro ix aji: Haton jun altar yet' juntzanh mexa b'aj tz'ak'chajem ixim pan t'a yichanh Jehová,
yet' juntzanh sb'akhnub' candil yet' candil tz'och sk'ak'al t'a yichanh jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji, icha yaj yalan Jehová chi'.
Ix b'o pax juntzanh yechel xumak ayoch t'a sb'akhnub' candil chi' yet' k'e'en tenaza,

k'e'en tz'ik'anel stanhil b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al candil, k'e'en niwak uk'ab', k'e'en niwak cuchara yet' k'e'en yet'tal tzak'ak'. Masanil juntzanh k'e'en chi', anhej t'a k'e'en oro te wach' b'aj ix b'o'i. Ix och pax k'e'en oro t'a spatiktak puerta b'aj tzonh och t'a yol templo chi'. Ix och pax k'e'en t'a spuerta'il jun lugar Yiknhej Dios Yaji.

Haxo yik ix lajwi masanil munlajel ix schek b'ojok winhaj Salomón t'a stemplo Jehová chi', ix ik'jib'at masanil juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji yikok Jehová t'a yol templo chi', haton juntzanh yamk'ab' nab'a oro, nab'a plata yet' juntzanhxo tastak yik Jehová yajkan yuj winhaj rey David smam winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' haxo t'a sk'uhal k'inh te niwan yelk'och t'a yukil uj t'a yol ab'il chi', ix schekan winhaj Salomón chi' smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel chi' t'a Jerusalén yet' masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal yet' heb' niwak yelk'och t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok. Ix smolb'ej sb'a heb', yik tz'ik'chajkot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová yuj heb' levita t'a Sion, haton schonhab' winhaj David.
Ix yik'ankot jun mantiado heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita, haton jun b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ix jawi heb' yet'ok t'a templo chi' yet' masanil syamk'ab'il.

Ha winhaj rey Salomón yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal molanek' chi', b'ab'el skot heb' t'a yichanh te' skaxa'il strato Dios chi', snhusan nok' silab' heb', haton nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax. Manh jantakok nok' ix yak' heb', manhxo b'ischajb'enok nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yak'anoch te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi' heb' sacerdote t'a yol templo chi' t'a yichochk'ochi, haton t'a jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji, t'a yalanh sk'axil juntzanh yechel querubín.
Ha juntzanh yechel querubín chi', jenhanb'at sk'axil t'a yib'anh b'aj ix kan te' kaxa chi' yet' t'a yib'anh te' sb'akhnub'al.

Ha te' sb'akhlab'il te' kaxa chi', najat ste'el te', chekel te' t'a jun lugar ay t'a snanhal yol templo chi', jun ay t'a sat elta jun lugar Yiknhej Dios Yaji, palta manh chekelok te' t'a sti'. Ha t'a jun lugar chi' ix kannhej te' kaxa chi'.

Ha tas ayem t'a yol te', anhej chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en yak'nakkanem winhaj Moisés t'a Horeb. Ha t'a k'e'en tz'ib'ab'ilkanoch strato Jehová sb'onak yet' chonhab' Israel ayik wan skot heb' t'a yol b'e ayik yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto.
Ix elta heb' sacerdote t'a jun lugar ay t'a snanhal yol templo chi'. Toxo ix sakb'itej sb'a heb' smasanil, wach'chom manto k'och stzolal yoch heb' t'a yopisio.

Haxo masanil heb' levita ak'b'iloch yik sb'itani, haton winhaj Asaf, winhaj Hemán, winhaj Jedutún, heb' yuninal heb' winh yet' heb' sk'ab' yok heb' winh, linhjab'och heb' winh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a stz'ey altar t'a yamak'il templo chi'. Nab'a lino spichul heb' winh ayochi, yet'nak platillo heb' winh, salterio yet' arpa. Ay pax 120 heb' winh sacerdote spu'an k'e'en trompeta.

Junnhej ix aj spu'an k'e'en trompeta chi' heb' winh smasanil. Junnhej ix aj sjaj heb' winh sb'itani, yik syalan wach' lolonel heb' winh yuj yak'an yuj diosal heb' winh t'a Jehová. Yakb'an wan sb'itan heb' winh chi', ix puchaj k'e'en trompeta, ix tzinhji platillo yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik b'it chi'. Sb'itan heb' winh icha tik: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto te wach'nhej, tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb'. Ha t'a jun rato chi' ix b'ut'ji'el yol templo chi' yuj jun asun.
Majxo yal-laj yoch heb' winh sacerdote yil yopisio, yujto ix b'ut'ji'el yol templo chi' yuj stzikiki'al Jehová.
Ix yalan winhaj rey Salomón icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ix ala' to t'a skal k'ik' k'inal ayach ek'i.
Palta a in tik, ix in b'ok'e jun a templo wach' yilji tik yik tzach kajnaj t'a yo'ol. Haton t'a tik ol ach aj t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh rey chi' t'a Dios.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh rey chi' b'aj ayek' masanil heb' yetisraelal chi', linhjab' k'e heb' smasanil, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, yujto ix elk'och b'aj yak'nakkan sti' t'a winhaj David in mam, ayik yalannak icha tik:

Atax yik wik'annakelta in chonhab' t'a Egipto, malaj junokxo chonhab' ix in sik'el t'a skal yinhtilal Israel b'aj sb'o junok templo b'aj tzin aji, yik tz'ik'jicha'anh in b'i. Malaj pax junok winak ix in sik'eli yik skuchb'an in chonhab' Israel tik.
Palta a tikne'ik jun, ix in sik'el chonhab' Jerusalén, yik wach' hata' ol b'inaj in b'i. Ix ach in sik'paxeli yik tzach och reyal t'a in chonhab' Israel tik, xchi Jehová t'a winh in mam chi'.
Ha winhaj David in mam chi', snib'ejnak winh sb'ok'e junok templo yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová ko Diosal winh.
Palta yalnak Jehová t'a winh: Te wach' tas tza na chi', yujto tza na a b'ok'e junok in templo.
Manhok ach ol a b'ok'e'i, palta a junok uninal ol b'o'ank'e'ok, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo tikne'ik jun, toxo ix elk'och b'aj yak'nak sti' Jehová chi'. Icha wal yutejnak yalan chi', icha chi' ix aj woch reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik sk'exulok winh in mam chi'. Toxo ix in b'ok'e jun stemplo Jehová ko Diosal.
Toxo pax ix wak'och te' skaxa'il strato Jehová sb'onak ket'ok t'a yo'ol, xchi winh.

Ay jun tek'nub' nab'a bronce ix schek winhaj Salomón chi' b'ojok, ha t'a snanhal yamak'il templo chi' ay, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro ix aj schanhil pak'anh. Haxo scha'anhil ix ajk'e'i, jun metro yet' 35 centímetro. Ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh jun tek'nub' chi' t'a yichanh altar yik Jehová, k'elanoch masanil heb' chonhab' israel chi' ix em kuman winh, ix yik'ancha'anh sk'ab' winh, ix lesalwi winh.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, malaj junokxo Dios t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik lajan het'ok, yujto tzak'elk'och a trato, tza ch'oxan a wach'k'olal t'a mach tzach k'anab'ajan t'a smasanil sk'o'ol.
Toxo ix ak'elk'och b'aj ak'nak a ti' t'a winhaj David in mam. Ha wal tikne'ik wan yelk'ochi.

Yuj chi', Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, elokab'paxk'och b'aj ak'nak a ti' t'a winh a chekab' aj David chi' to ol ochnhej yinhtilal winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel tik tato tzach sk'anab'ajej heb' icha ajnak ach sk'anab'ajan winh in mam chi'.
Yuj chi', Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, elokab'k'och b'aj ak'nak a ti' t'a winh in mam a chekab' chi'.
Palta jun, ¿tom syal a kajnaj t'a sat lum tik yet' heb' anima? Inatax satcha'anh, yelxo te niwan, palta max yab'laj b'aj tzach aji, okxom jab' templo ix in b'ok'e tik.
Palta jun Mamin, cha ab' in lesal ayik tzin tewi t'ayach a in a chekab' in tik, ayik tzin k'anan a wach'k'olal.
Manh ik'el a sat t'a jun templo tik t'a k'uhal yet' t'ak'walil, haton t'a jun lugar to ix ala' to ol ach b'inajnhej. Yuj chi' ab'wal tas swala'.
Ayik tzin lesalwi t'ayach yet' pax heb' a chonhab' Israel tik t'a jun lugar tik, cha ab' ko lesal tik. Hato t'a satcha'anh b'aj kajan ach, tza maklej ab' ko lesal chi', tzak'wal niwank'olal ko mul.
K'inalok ay junok mach tz'ak'ji'och t'a yib'anh to ix och smul t'a junok yetanima'il, tz'ik'chajkoti, tzul yak'an sti' t'a yichanh altar t'a jun a templo tik,
hato t'a satcha'anh chi', tzab' tas syala', tza b'eyk'olej t'a stojolal, tzak'och syahelal mach tz'och smul chi' icha syal smul tz'ochi, tza b'o pax yaj mach malaj smul.
K'inalok tzonh ak'ji ganar a onh a chonhab' onh tik yuj heb' kajk'o'ol, yujto tz'och ko mul t'ayach, tato sna sb'a ko k'o'ol, skalan ko b'a t'ayach, tzonh tewi t'ayach t'a jun templo tik,
tzab'wal ko lesal t'a satcha'anh chi', tzak'wal niwank'olal ko mul, tzonh ak' meltzaj t'a lum ko lu'um ak'nak t'a heb' ko mam kicham tik.

K'inalok manhxo ol yak' nhab' t'a chonhab' tik yuj ko mul tz'och t'ayach, tzak'anoch ko yahelal. Palta tato tzonh jawi ul ach kak' b'inaj t'a lesal, k'elan onh kot t'a jun lugar tik sna'an sb'a ko k'o'ol t'a ko chukal yuj jun yahelal chi',

tzab'wal t'a satcha'anh chi' ayik tzonh tewi t'ayach. Tzak'wal niwank'olal ko chukal, tza ch'ox jun a b'eyb'al wach' yik sko b'eyb'alej. Slajwi chi' tzak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum ak'nak tik t'ayonh.

K'inalok tz'em wejel, ma ilya t'a ko chonhab' tik, ma stakji kawb'en yuj k'ak', ma sjawi junok syab'il kawb'en chi', ma sjawi nok' k'ulub' t'ay, ma junokxo makan nok' kotak nok' slajanel kawb'en chi', ma jun, sjawi hoyan heb' ajk'ol yak'an owal t'a junok chonhab' t'a yol ko makb'en tik, ma yalnhej tas yahelal tzonh ik'ani,

tzab'wal ko lesal ayik tzonh tewi t'ayach. Yalnhej mach sna sb'a sk'o'ol ayik syilani to ayoch t'a syahelal, tato smojb'ejkot sk'ab' t'ayach t'a stojolal jun templo tik, tzab'wal tas syal chi' t'a satcha'anh, tzak'wal spak t'a junjun icha sb'eyb'al, yujto a ach tik ojtak wal tas ay t'a ko pensar yet' tas sko na junjun onh.
Tato icha chi', ol yal sb'a masanil a chonhab' t'ayach, ol ach ko k'anab'ajani yakb'an pitzan onh t'a sat jun lu'um ak'nak tik t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

K'inalok ay junok anima ch'ok chonhab'il skot t'a junok lugar najat yik skajnaj t'a ko kal a onh a chonhab' onh tik yujto te niwan a b'inaji, te niwan a poder, tato slesalwi t'ayach t'a stojolal jun a templo tik,

tzab'wal tas syal chi' t'a satcha'anh b'aj ayach, tzak' masanil tas sk'an chi' t'ayach, yik wach' tzach yojtakejel masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yik wach' tzach sk'anab'ajej heb' icha tzach ko k'anab'ajej a onh a chonhab' Israel onh tik. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a jun templo ix in b'ok'e tik, ik yaji.

K'inalok yalnhej b'aj tzonh a chekb'at a onh a chonhab' onh tik kak' owal yet' heb' ajk'o'ol, tato tzonh lesalwi t'ayach t'a stojolal jun chonhab' ix a sik'kanel tik, b'aj ay jun templo ix in b'ok'e tik,
tzab'wal t'a satcha'anh chi' ayik tzonh tewi t'ayach, tzach och ket'ok yik skak' ganar.

K'inalok tz'och ko mul t'ayach, (yujto malaj junok anima max och smul) skot yowal a k'ol t'ayonh, yuj chi' tzonh ak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, tzonh yik'anb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il najat, ma lak'an.
Tato sna sb'a ko k'o'ol t'a jun chonhab' b'aj ayonhek' chi', tzach ko na'anxikoti, tzonh tewi t'ayach, sko cha'an ko mulej t'ayach, tzab'wal ko lesal.

Tato yet' smasanil ko k'o'ol yet' smasanil ko pensar tzach ko naxikoti, ayik ayonh ek' t'a jun chonhab' b'aj ik'b'ilonhb'at chi', tzonh lesalwikot t'a stojolal jun lum ak'nak tik t'a heb' ko mam kicham yet' jun chonhab' sik'b'ilel u'uj tik yet' t'a stojolal jun templo ix in b'o tik,
tato icha chi', hato t'a satcha'anh b'aj ayach ek'i, tzab'wal ko lesal, tzach och ket'ok yik tzonh meltzajxi, tzak'wal niwank'olal ko mul tz'och chi' t'ayach.
Ach in Diosal, tza maklej wal ab' lesal tz'ochnhej t'ayach t'a jun lugar tik.
Ach Jehová ko Diosal, kanannhej kajan t'a jun lugar tik yet' skaxa'il sch'oxanel a poder. Mamin, kolnhej heb' sacerdote tzach ak'an serwil, haxo heb' iko', tzalajokab' heb' yuj a wach'k'olal.
Manh in a patikejel a in rey in ix in a sik'kanel tik. Nakot b'aj a xajanejnak winhaj David a chekab', xchi winhaj rey Salomón chi' t'a Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi slesalwi winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix kot k'ak' t'a satcha'anh, ix tz'ab'at jun silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil yet' juntzanhxo silab', ix b'ut'ji'el yol templo chi' yuj stzikiki'al Jehová.
Yuj chi' majxo yal-laj yoch heb' sacerdote t'a yo'ol chi'.

Ayik ix yilan jun k'ak' chi' masanil heb' israel yet' stzikiki'al Jehová ix emul t'a yib'anh jun templo chi', ix em kumnaj heb' masanto ix emk'och snanhal sat heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix lesalwi heb', ix yak'an yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: Yelxo te wach' Dios, yujto tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix lajwi juntzanh chi', ix yak'an silab' winhaj rey Salomón yet' heb' chonhab' chi' t'a Jehová.
Ix yak' 22 mil nok' wakax heb' yet' 120 mil nok' kalnel silab'il. Icha chi' ix aj yak'ankanoch jun templo chi' heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.

Linhank'e masanil heb' israel chi', haxo heb' sacerdote ayek' heb' t'a yet'tal b'aj ix kani, spu'an k'e'en strompeta heb'. Haxo heb' levita k'elk'umb'a yaj heb' yet' heb' sacerdote chi', wan sb'itan heb' yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey David yik tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová. Wan sb'itan heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová, aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb'.

Ix yak'anpaxoch yopisio snanhal amak' winhaj Salomón chi', haton jun ay t'a yichanh stemplo Jehová chi', yik hata' snhusjitz'a silab' yet' xepu'al nok' silab' yik junk'olal yet' Dios, yujto a jun altar nab'a bronce ix schek winh b'ojok, max yab'laj yik sk'e nok' silab' chi' t'a yib'anh yet' ofrenda t'a tas swaji yet' xepu'al nok' nok' chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winhaj Salomón yet' heb' yetisraelal ix yak'och k'inh chinama heb' t'a uke' k'uhal. Te niwan sb'isul heb', ix kotnhej heb' b'aj tz'ochk'och b'e t'a Hamat t'a norte, masanto t'a ha' eluma' yik Egipto t'a sur.
Uke' k'uhal ix yak'och sk'inhal jun altar chi' heb', haxo t'a junxo uke' k'uhal, ix yak'anoch k'inh chinama chi' heb'. Haxo t'a jun slajwub' k'uhal chi' ix yak'anoch jun niwan k'inh heb'.

Ha t'a 23 yoch yukil uj chi', ix spuklan sb'a winhaj rey Salomón chi' yet' masanil anima ayek' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxkan heb' t'a spat t'a tzalajk'olal. Ix te tzalaj heb' yuj jantak tas wach' ak'b'il yuj Jehová t'a winhaj David, t'a winhaj Salomón chi' yet' t'a masanil chonhab' Israel.
Ayik toxo ix b'o'el stemplo Jehová yuj winhaj rey Salomón chi' yet' spalacio winh yet' masanil tastak ix sna' winh to sb'ochaji,
ix sch'oxan sb'a Jehová t'a winh t'ak'walil, ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: Ix wab' wal a lesal, ix in sik'anpaxel jun lugar tik wikok yik tz'och in kajnub'ok b'aj stz'a silab' t'ayin.
Yuj chi', k'inalok swak'kot k'ak', maxtzak yak' nhab', ma swak'kot nok' k'ulub' sk'uxanb'at awb'en, ma swak'kot junok ilya t'a eyib'anh a ex in chonhab' ex tik,

tato a ex ojtakab'il to wik ex, tzex lesalwi t'ayin, slajwi chi' tzeyaktankan he chuk b'eyb'al chi', tato icha chi', swab' he lesal chi' t'a satcha'anh, swak'an niwank'olal he mul, swak'anxi tastak ay t'a he chonhab' chi'.
Ha tikne'ik yet' yik ol b'eynhejb'atok, ol wab'nhej lesal ol och t'ayin t'a jun templo tik,
yujto toxo ix in sik'kaneli yik tz'ochkan wikok. Ol in ajnhej kajan t'ay, ol in tanhwej.
Ha tikne'ik jun, tato wach'nhej ol utej a b'a t'ayin icha wal yutejnak sb'a winh a mam, tato ol a k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il yet' masanil tas ix wal t'ayach,
ol wak'nhejelk'och opisio tik, icha wal in trato in b'onak yet' winh a mam chi', ayik walannak to ol ochnhej yinhtilal winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel tik.
Palta tato a ex tik ol eyik'el he b'a t'ayin, manh ol he k'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il ix wak' t'ayex, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'aj ol eyak'em he b'a, ol ex och pax ejmelal t'ay,
ol ex wik'el t'a sat lum lum wak'nak tik t'ayex. Ha jun templo ix ochkan wikok tik, ol wik'kanel t'a wichanh, ol wak'an b'uchjok yuj masanil nación.

Ha jun templo manhxo jantakok swach'il yilji tik, toxonhej ol k'ekan b'ulan spojelal. Masanil mach ol ek' t'a stz'ey, ol te sat sk'ol heb' yilani, ol sk'anb'an heb', ¿tas yuj icha tik ix yutej jun chonhab' tik Jehová yet' jun templo tik? xcham heb'.

Haxo ol aj yalji t'a heb': Icha tik ix aji yujto ix yaktejkan Jehová sDiosal smam yicham heb', haton Dios ik'jinakelta heb' t'a Egipto, haxo juntzanh komon Dios b'aj ix yak'em sb'a heb'. Yuj wal chi' ix yak'kot jun niwan yahelal tik t'a yib'anh heb', xcham heb', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi', 20 ab'il ix yak' winh sb'o'ank'e spalacio yet' stemplo Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'o'anxik'e juntzanh chonhab' winh, haton juntzanh ix yak'xikan winhaj rey Hiram t'a winh, ix yak'an kajnaj heb' israel winh t'ay.
Ixlajwi chi, ix b'at winhaj Salomón chi' yak' owal t'a chonhab' Hamat t'a yol yik Soba, ix yak'an ganar winh.
Ix sb'o'anxik'e chonhab' Tadmor winh, jun ay t'a takinh lu'um yet' juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Hamat b'aj smolchaj masanil tas swaji.

Hanhejtona' ix sb'oxik'e chonhab' Bet-horón winh, jun ay t'a yib'anhk'e'i yet' Bet-horón ay t'a yalanhemta. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', ayoch smuro'al yet' spuerta'il. Aypaxoch k'atan k'e'en k'e'en syamnub'alok spuerta'il chi'.

Ix sb'o'anxik'e chonhab' Baalat winh yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' b'aj smolchaj masanil tas swaji. Ix sb'o'anpax juntzanh yet'tal carruaje winh yik owal yet' b'aj tz'aj nok' chej yik owal yet' masanil tas snib'ej winh ix sb'o t'a Jerusalén chi', t'a Líbano yet' t'a masanil yol smakb'en.

Ay pax juntzanh yinhtilal heb' anima manh satb'ilokel yuj heb' israel aykan kajan t'a skal heb', haton heb' heteo, heb' amorreo, heb' heveo, heb' ferezeo yet' heb' jebuseo. Ha heb' chi' manh israelok heb'. Ix ak'jikanoch heb' t'a munlajel yuj winhaj Salomón chi'.

Palta malaj junok heb' yetisraelal winh ix yak' pural yak'anoch t'a munlajel chi'. Ix yak'och heb' winh t'a soldado'al, t'a sat yajalil heb' winh soldado, t'a yajalil t'a heb' ayoch t'a carruaje yik owal yet' t'a heb' winh soldado sk'e t'a yib'anh chej. Hata' ix yak'och heb' yetisraelal winh chi'.
Haxo heb' sat yajal tz'ilan heb' smunlaj chi', 250 heb'.

Ha winhaj Salomón chi', ix yik'el ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto winh b'aj kajan t'a schonhab' winhaj David, ix yik'anb'at ix winh t'a junxo palacio ix sb'o winh yikok ix, yujto ix sna' winh to manh smojok skajnaj ix b'aj ek'nak sdespacho winhaj rey David, yujto hata' ek'nak te' skaxa'il strato Jehová, te niwan yelk'och jun lugar chi'.
Ix yak' nhusjoktz'a silab' winhaj rey Salomón t'a Jehová t'a yib'anh altar ix sb'ok'e t'a yichanh templo chi'.

Haton t'a juntzanh k'uhal alb'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés t'a ley to tz'ak'ji silab' chi', hata' ix yak' nhusjoktz'a juntzanh silab' chi' winh: Haton t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, t'a k'inh yik tz'alji k'e'en uj yet' pax t'a oxe' niwak k'inh tz'och t'a yol ab'il: Haton k'inh yik ixim pan malaj yich, k'inh ayik slajwi smolji sat awb'en yet' k'inh yik chinama.

Ix yak'anpaxoch heb' sacerdote winh yet' heb' levita t'a munlajel t'a templo t'a stzolal. Ix ak'ji'och heb' t'a yopisio chi', icha yajkan yalan winhaj David smam winh. Ay juntzanh heb' levita yopisio sb'itan t'a Jehová, skolwaj heb' yet' heb' sacerdote t'a junjun k'u. Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' stanhwan spuerta'il templo chi'
yet' b'aj smolb'aj tastak yik templo. Yuj chi' malaj wal jab'ok ix sk'ex winh tastak tz'aj smunlaj heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita icha yajkan yuj winhaj David chi'.
Masanil munlajel nab'il yuj winhaj rey Salomón chi', yiktax ix em yich stemplo Jehová masanto ix b'o'eli, wach' ix aj yik'an sb'a smasanil.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Salomón chi' t'a Ezión-geber yet' t'a Elat, t'a stitak ha' Chakchak Mar, t'a yol yik Edom.

Ix yak'kot juntzanh te' barco winhaj Hiram yet' heb' smunlajtaxon t'a te' barco chi'. Ha heb' winh chi', yojtak heb' winh yek' t'a yib'anh ha' mar. Ix xit'ek' heb' winh yet' heb' schekab' winhaj Salomón chi' t'a Ofir. Kenxonhej manh 320 quintalok k'e'en oro ix jawi yuj heb' t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ha ix sreina'il Sabá, ix yab' spekal ix to a winhaj rey Salomón, te niwan yelk'och winh, yuj chi' ix jawi ix t'a Jerusalén yik tzul sk'anb'an juntzanh lolonel ix te ajaltak snachajeli, yik syil ix tato yel te jelan winhaj Salomón chi'. Niwan heb' schekab' ix yet'nak, niwan nok' camello kuchjinak perfume, niwan k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji yet'nak ix. Ayik ix jawi ix yil winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix sk'anb'an ix t'a winh masanil tas nab'il yuj.
Haxo ix spakan masanil tas ix sk'anb'ej ix chi' winh, malaj junok tas ix sk'anb'ej ix chi' maj yal spakan winh.
Ayik ix yilan ix reina chi' jantak sjelanil winhaj Salomón chi' yet' spalacio winh b'ob'il yuj,

yet' tastak swa winh t'a sat smexa yet' b'aj ay heb' ay yopisio yet' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' schekab' winh yet' spichul heb', te ch'okxo pax yilji spichul heb' tz'ak'an swino winh rey chi' yet' juntzanh silab' snhusjitz'a t'a stemplo Jehová, ix te sat sk'o'ol ix yilan masanil juntzanh chi'.
Ix yalan ix t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha tas ix wab' t'a in chonhab' yuj jantak tas ix a b'o'o yet' jantak a jelanil sb'inaji, yel ton wal.

Ayik ix wab'an chi', maj wak'ochlaj t'a in k'ol tastak tz'alchaj chi', palta haxo tikne'ik jun, swil wal yet' yol in sat. Max k'ek'ochlaj nanhal juntzanh swil tik ix alji wab'i, yujto a a jelanil tik, yelxo wal ek'to t'a yichanh tas ix wab' chi'.
Te wach' yik heb' tzach ak'an serwil, te wach' yik heb' aynhejek' het'ok, syab'an a jelanil heb'.

Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová a Diosal, ste tzalaj het'ok, yuj chi' ix ach yak'och reyal yik tza ch'oxan yajalil. Te xajan chonhab' Israel tik yuj a Diosal chi', yujto snib'ej to aynhej ek' jun chonhab' tik t'a masanil tiempo, yuj chi' ach yak'och sreyalok, yik tzak'an reyal t'a swach'ilal yet' t'a stojolal, xchi ix reina chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an 100 quintal k'e'en oro ix t'a winh yet' jantak perfume yet' k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji. Malaj junelok niwan perfume chi' ix jawi t'a Israel icha ix si'ej ix sreina'il Sabá chi' t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi'.

Hanheja' pax heb' winh winak smunlaj t'a winhaj Hiram yet' heb' winh smunlaj t'a winhaj Salomón chi', ix xit'ek' heb' winh yik'kot k'e'en oro t'a Ofir, ix yik'anpaxkot te' sándalo heb' winh yet' k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji.

Ha yet' te' sándalo chi' ix schek winh rey chi' b'ojok sb'e'al stemplo Jehová yet' spalacio winh b'akhkiltak sk'e'i yet' stitak. Ha yet' te' chi' ix sb'opax te' arpa winh yet' salterio yik sk'an heb' tz'ak'an juntzanh yamk'ab' chi'. Malaj b'aj tz'ilchaj te' lajan yet' te' chi' t'a yol smakb'en Judá.

Ix el t'a sk'ol winh rey chi' yak'an masanil tas ix sk'an ix sreina'il Sabá chi'. Ch'ok pax yaj tas toxo ix yak' winh sk'exulok tastak ix yik'kot ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax ix t'a schonhab' chi' yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' ix.
Ha k'e'en oro scha' winhaj Salomón t'a junjun ab'il, 500 quintal k'e'en.
Ch'ok pax yaj k'e'en syak' heb' chonhwajum yet' pax k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata syak' heb' sreyal Arabia yet' heb' ayoch t'a yopisio t'a junjun makan smakb'en Israel.
Ix schek winh b'ochaj 200 niwak maklab' jul-lab', ayoch k'e'en oro t'ay, ay am lajchawe'ok libra k'e'en oro ayoch t'a junjun.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanpax winh b'ojok 300 xo yunetak maklab' jul-lab' chi'. Ay am wake'ok libra k'e'en oro ix och t'a junjun. Haxo t'a jun niwan pat skuchan Te te' yik Líbano ix yak'kan winh.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ojok jun sk'ojnub' t'a sdespacho, ix ak'ji'och k'e'en oro te wach' t'ay, ix ak'jipaxoch marfil yelwanub'ok.

Ha jun k'ojnub' chi', wak tzol sk'e sb'akhkiltakil sk'o'ochal. Aypaxem k'e'en oro b'aj tz'em b'akhan yok winh rey chi', yaman yaj yet' jun k'ojnub' chi'. Ayk'e sk'ab' jun k'ojnub' chi' t'a junjun stz'eytak. B'ob'ilpaxoch yechel junjun nok' choj t'a junjun sk'ab' chi'.
Ay pax lajchawexo yechel nok' choj chi', junjun aykan t'a snhitak junjun sb'akhkiltakil chi'. Malaj junokxo rey b'o'annak yik icha yik winh chi'.

Masanil skopa winh rey chi', nab'a oro yet' masanil yamk'ab' ay t'a jun niwan pat skuch Te te' yik Líbano. Malaj junok yamk'ab' chi' plata, yujto ha t'a stiempo'al winh rey chi', a k'e'en plata chi' malaj yelk'och k'e'en.

Ha heb' schekab' winh rey chi', sb'at heb' yet' heb' schekab' winhaj Hiram yet' juntzanh niwak barco icha te' sb'at t'a Tarsis. Oxe' ab'il sb'atkan heb' yik sb'at yik'ankot k'e'en oro heb', k'e'en plata, marfil, nok' chab'in yet' nok' pawo real.
Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi', ek'b'al sb'eyumal winh yet' pax sjelanil winh t'a yichanh masanil heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Masanil heb' winh rey chi', ix jawi heb' winh t'a winh yik tzul yilan heb' winh, ma tzul yab'an heb' winh jantak sjelanil winh ix ak'ji yuj Dios.
Masanil heb' chi' ix yik'kot silab' heb' t'a winh t'a junjun ab'il: Haton k'e'en plata, k'e'en oro, pichul, yamk'ab' yik owal, perfume, nok' chej yet' nok' mula.

Ay 4 mil spatil nok' chej yet' carruaje yik winhaj rey Salomón chi' yet' 12 mil nok' chej skuchan heb' soldado. Ay carruaje yet' nok' chej ayek' yet' heb' stanhwumal winh rey t'a Jerusalén, ay pax ayek' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'.
Ix yak' reyal winh t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey skotnhej t'a ha' Éufrates, masanto sk'och t'a yol yik heb' filisteo, sk'och t'a smojonal Egipto.
Ha t'a Jerusalén chi', a k'e'en plata icha komon k'e'en ix aj k'e'en yuj winh rey chi'. Haxo te' k'ute', lajan ix aj te' icha te' kaltakte'al higo t'a yichtak witz.
Ha nok' schej winh rey chi', ha t'a Egipto skot nok' yet' t'a juntzanhxo nación.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Salomón chi', ayik ix el yich masanto slajwub', tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ch'anh yu'um winhaj Natán schekab' Dios yet' t'a ch'anh yik winhaj Ahías schekab' Dios aj Silo yet' t'a ch'anh b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan tas ix ch'oxji yil winh schekab' Dios skuch Iddo yik tz'alji yuj winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel,
haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukchaj winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David smam winh. Ixlajwi chi' haxo winhaj Roboam yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ix b'at winhaj Roboam t'a chonhab' Siquem, yujto hata' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' yetisraelal winh, yik tz'ak'jikanoch winh reyal yuj heb'.
Ix k'och spekal jun tik t'a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat t'a Egipto, yuj chi' ix paxta winh, yujto hata' k'ochnakkan winh ayik yelnak winh elelal t'a winhaj Salomón.
Ix awtajkot winhaj Jeroboam chi' yuj heb' yetisraelal. Ayik ix jawi winh, ix b'at winh yet' heb' yik sb'at lolon heb' yet' winhaj Roboam chi'. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik:
--Ha winh a mam, yelxo te ya munlajel ayoch yuj winh t'a kib'anh. Haxo tikne'ik jun, ik'el jab'ok munlajel ya ayoch t'a kib'anh tik, ol kak'nhejoch ko b'a t'a yalanh a mandar, xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Roboam chi' t'a heb': --Hato chab'ej tzul in eyilxi, swal t'ayex tas tz'aji, xchi winh t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix pax heb' anima chi' smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Roboam chi' t'a heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab', haton heb' winh munlajnak yet' winhaj Salomón smam winh icha tik: --¿Tas junok pensar tzeyak' t'ayin? ¿Tas swutej tak'wok in b'a t'a juntzanh anima tik? xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Tato wach'nhej ol utej a b'a t'a heb' anima tik, ol a k'anab'ajan a b'o'an tas snib'ej heb' chi', tato wach' pax ol utok a tak'wi t'a heb', ol yak'nhejoch sb'a heb' t'a yalanh a mandar t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb' winh.

Palta maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh ichamtak winak chi'. Haxo t'a juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak junnhej k'ib'nak winh yet'ok, hata' ix sk'anb'ej pax spensar winh chi', haton heb' winh ayoch t'a opisio yet' winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas junok pensar tzeyak' t'ayin a ex tik? ¿Tas swutej tak'wok in b'a t'a juntzanh anima tik? Snib'ej heb' swik'el jab'ok munlajel aykanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yuj winh in mam, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak winak chi' icha tik: --Ha heb' tz'alan chi' to tzik'el jab'ok munlajel aykanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yuj winh a mam chi', al t'a heb' icha tik: Tato ya munlajel b'aj ayex och yuj winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto sya'il b'aj ol ex wak'ochi.

Tato al ix yutej eyikatz winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto yalil ol wutej eyikatz chi'. Tato anhej nok' tz'u'um ix yak'lab'ej winh in mam chi' ex smak'ani, a inxo tik, a nok' tz'um ayoch k'e'en t'a snhi' ol wak'lab'ej t'ayex, xa chi t'a heb', xchi heb' winh.
Haxo t'a schab'ji'al chi', ix jax winhaj Jeroboam yet' masanil heb' anima chi' t'a winhaj rey Roboam chi', icha ix aj yalan winh t'a heb'.
Palta te chuk ix yutej winh spakan t'a heb'. Maj sk'anab'ajej winh tas ix yal heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi'.

Ha tas ix yal heb' winh kelemtak winak chi', a ix yal winh t'a heb' icha tik: Tato al ix yutej eyikatz winh in mam chi', a inxo tik, ek'alto ol wutej yalil eyikatz chi'. Tato anhej nok' tz'um ix yak'lab'ej winh ex smak'ani, a inxo pax tik, a nok' tz'u'um ayoch k'e'en t'a snhi' ol wak'lab'ej t'ayex, xchi winh.
Maj schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ix yal heb' anima chi', yujto a Jehová ix ak'an sk'ulej winh yik wach' tz'elk'och tas ix schek yal winhaj Ahías aj Silo t'a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat.

Ayik ix yilan masanil heb' anima chi' to maj scha yab' winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: Manhxalaj kalan kik t'a yinhtilal winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí. Ch'ok yinhtil heb', ch'ok pax kinhtilal. Ex ketisraelal, konh paxek t'a ko pat junjun onh. Olxo yil sb'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj David tik, xchi heb'. Ha t'a jun rato chi' ix laj pax heb' t'a spat.

Ixlajwi chi', ix chekjib'at winhaj Adoram yuj winhaj Roboam t'a heb' israel ix paxkan chi'. Ha winhaj Adoram chi' ay yopisio yilan heb' ak'b'il pural smunlaji. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a heb' ix paxkan chi', ix julk'enajcham winh yuj heb'. Yuj chi' ix k'e winhaj Roboam chi' t'a yol scarruaje, ix kot winh elelal, ix jawi winh t'a Jerusalén. Icha chi' ix aj yelkan heb' israel chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yinhtilal winhaj David. Haxonhej juntzanhxo heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá b'aj ix yak' reyal winh.

Ayik ix jawi winhaj Roboam chi' t'a Jerusalén, ix smolb'an 180 mil soldado winh, heb' sik'b'ilel t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá yet' t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, yik sb'at heb' yak' owal t'a juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal chi', yik tz'ochxikan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh junelxo.
Palta ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Semaías schekab' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Roboam yuninal winhaj Salomón sreyal Judá chi', yet' t'a masanil heb' israel kajan t'a yol yik Judá chi' yet' t'a heb' yik Benjamín

to a in swal icha tik: Manh eyak' owal yet' heb' eyetisraelal chi'. Meltzajanhek t'a he pat he masanil, yujto a in ix wak'elk'och jun tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'. Ayik ix yab'an heb' tas ix yal Jehová chi', ix pax heb' t'a spat junjun, majxo b'atlaj heb' yak' owal yet' winhaj Jeroboam, winh ix och sreyalok heb' ix pax chi'.

Ix kannhej winhaj Roboam chi' t'a Jerusalén, ix swach' b'o'an smuro'al juntzanh chonhab' winh, juntzanh ay t'a yol smakb'en Judá yet' Benjamín: Haton Belén, Etam, Tecoa, Bet-sur, Soco, Adulam, Gat, Maresa, Zif, Adoraim, Laquis, Azeca, Zora, Ajalón yet' Hebrón.
Wach' ix aj sb'ochajoch smuro'al juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix yak'anoch heb' yajalil soldado winh stanhwej. Niwan ixim trigo, aceite yet' wino ix molchaj t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Ix yak'anpaxkan smaklab' jul-lab' winh yet' k'e'en lanza t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', yik syal skolan sb'a t'a owal. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan yopisio winhaj Roboam chi' t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yol yik Benjamín.
Ha heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita, ix kot heb' t'a yol smakb'en Israel, yik syak'anoch sb'a heb' yet' winhaj Roboam chi'.

Ha heb' levita chi', ix yaktejkan schonhab' heb' yet' lum b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb', ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yik skajnaj heb' ta', yujto a winhaj Jeroboam yet' heb' tzak'anto ochnak reyal yuj winh ix pechanel heb' t'a yopisio yak'an serwil Jehová.

Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi', ix yak'och heb' komon anima winh sacerdote'al yak'an serwil komon Dios, yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh, t'a heb' enemigo yet' t'a juntzanh yechel wakax ix schek winh b'ojok.

Haxo heb' ay t'a junjun yinhtilal heb' israel to ayoch spensar yoch ejmelal t'a Jehová Dios, ix kot tzak'an heb' yet' heb' sacerdote yik Jehová chi' yet' heb' levita pax chi'. Ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén chi', yik wach' syal yak'an silab' heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' smam yicham.
Yuj chi' ix tek'k'aj yopisio winhaj Roboam chi' t'a smakb'en Judá t'a oxe' ab'il, yujto anhej oxe' ab'il chi' ix sb'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al winhaj David yet' winhaj Salomón winh.
Ha winhaj Roboam chi', ix yik' ix Mahalat winh yisil winhaj Jerimot yuninal winhaj David, a ix snun ix, haton ix Abihail yisil winhaj Eliab, yixchikin winhaj Isaí.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Roboam yet' ix Mahalat chi', haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Semarías yet' winhaj Zaham.
Ix yik'anpax ix Maaca winh, ix yisil winhaj Absalón. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, haton winhaj Abías, winhaj Atai, winhaj Ziza yet' winhaj Selomit.

Ha winhaj Roboam chi', 18 heb' ix yetb'eyum winh yet' 60 heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh. 28 yuninal winh yet' 60 heb' ix yisil. Ha ix Maaca chi', te xajan ix yuj winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ix chi'.
Ix snib'ej winh to a winhaj Abiam yune' ix Maaca chi' ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok, yuj chi' ix yak'och winh winh yajalil t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' yuninal.

Wach' ix yutej winh sna'ani, yuj chi' ix spukb'at heb' yuninal winh chi' t'a juntzanh chonhab' ayoch smuro'al t'a yol yik Judá chi' yet' t'a yol yik Benjamín. Tzijtum tas ix yak' winh swa heb', tzijtum pax heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh ix yak'och winh.
Ayik toxo ix tek'k'aj yopisio winhaj Roboam chi' sna'ani, ix yaktankan winh sk'anab'ajan sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab'.
Yujto pit ix yutej sb'a heb' t'a Jehová chi', yuj chi' ayik oye' ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Roboam chi' reyal, ix jawi winhaj Sisac sreyal Egipto yak' owal t'a Jerusalén.

Ix jawi winh yet' mil 200 carruaje yik owal yet' pax 60 mil soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' pax jantak heb' winh soldado, manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb' winh. Ha heb' aj Libia, heb' aj Suca yet' heb' aj Etiopía ix kot yet' heb' aj Egipto chi'.
Ix ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' ayoch smuro'al t'a Judá yuj heb' masanto ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Yuj chi' ix k'och winh schekab' Dios skuchan Semaías t'a yichanh winhaj Roboam chi' yet' t'a heb' ayoch yajalil t'a smakb'en Judá. Molanek' heb' t'a Jerusalén chi' yuj xiwelal t'a winhaj Sisac chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Icha tik ix aj yalan Jehová: Yujto ix in eyaktejkani, yuj chi' toxo ix ex waktejkan t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Sisac chi', xchi, xchi winh.
Ha heb' yajal yaj yet' winh rey chi', emnakilxonhej ix aj yojtakanel spitalil heb', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Smojton wal icha chi' tzonh yutej Jehová chi', xchi heb'.

Ayik ix yilan Jehová to emnakil ix yutej sb'a heb', ix yalanxi t'a winhaj Semaías chi' icha tik: Yujto emnakil ix yutej sb'a heb', yuj chi' manh ol in satel heb', palta toxo wal ol in kol heb', manhxo ol wak'lab'ej winhaj Sisac chi' yik swak'anb'at jantak yowal in k'ol t'a chonhab' Jerusalén chi'.

Anhej b'i'an to ol kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Sisac chi', yik wach' ol nachajel yuj heb' to sekojtak wak'ji serwil t'a yichanh pax yak'ji serwil heb' winh sreyal juntzanhxo ch'ok nacional, xchi Jehová.

Ix jawi winhaj Sisac sreyal Egipto chi' yak' owal t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix yik'anb'at jantak b'eyumal winh sik'an t'a stemplo Jehová yet' t'a spalacio winh rey chi'. Ix yik'anpaxb'at juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' winh, haton juntzanh nab'a oro b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Salomón.
Haxo yet' k'e'en bronce ix sb'o juntzanhxo smaklab' jul-lab' winhaj Roboam chi' sk'exulok juntzanh nab'a oro chi', ix yak'ankan winh t'a heb' stanhwan sti' spalacio winh chi'.
Ayik sb'at winh rey chi' juntak el t'a stemplo Jehová, syik'anb'at maklab' jul-lab' chi' heb'. Haxo spaxta heb', syik'anxikanoch heb' t'a yet'tal b'aj stanhwej chi'.

Yujto ix yak'xi'och sb'a winhaj Roboam chi' t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yuj chi' ix och wa'an yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh winh, maj satji'el-laj masanil chonhab' yuj, yuj chi' wach' ix ajxikan heb' aj Judá.

Ix yik'xi yip yopisio winhaj Roboam chi' t'a Jerusalén chi'. 41 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal. 17 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén, haton jun chonhab' chi' sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová t'a yol smakb'en heb' israel yik skajnaj ta'. Naama sb'i ix snun winh, aj Amón ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh, te chuk, yujto maj yak'och winh t'a sk'ol sk'anab'ajan tas ix yal Jehová.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Roboam chi', ayik ix el yich masanto t'a slajwub', tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yumal yuj winhaj Semaías yet' t'a yumal yik winhaj Iddo, haton heb' winh schekab' Dios.
Ix yak'nhej owal winhaj Roboam yet' winhaj Jeroboam. Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Roboam chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Abías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Jeroboam reyal t'a Israel, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Abías yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Oxe' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Micaías sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Uriel aj Gabaa. Ix yak' owal winhaj Abías chi' yet' winhaj Jeroboam.

Ha winhaj Abías chi', ix b'at winh yet' 400 mil heb' winh soldado te tek'an, te jelan pax heb' winh t'a owal, haton heb' winh sik'b'ilel yuj winh. Haxo winhaj Jeroboam chi', ix kot pax winh yet' 800 mil heb' soldado sik'b'il pax el yuj winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Abías chi' t'a lum jolom witz Zemaraim t'a yol yik Efraín, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach Jeroboam yet' masanil israel ayek' het'ok, ab'ek:
¿Tom manh eyojtakok to a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik ix ak'ankan jun opisio tik t'a winhaj David yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal t'a junelnhej, yik syak'an reyal, jun trato max yal-laj sk'exchaji?
Haxo winhaj Jeroboam chi', winh yuninal winhaj Nabat, schekab' winhaj Salomón, ix och winh ajk'olal t'a winh yajalil chi'.

Ix yak'anoch sb'a juntzanh jaragana winak chuk spensar yet' winh, ix yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Roboam yuninal winhaj Salomón. Yujto unin winakto winhaj Roboam chi', manta wal spensar winh, yuj chi' maj yal stek'b'an sb'a winh t'a yichanh heb'.

Ha tikne'ik jun, a he na'ani to ol yal eyak'an owal ket' a onh yinhtil onh winhaj David tik, ak'b'il jun opisio tik t'ayonh yuj Jehová. Anhej yujto niwan he b'isul, eyet'nak pax juntzanh yechel wakax nab'a oro ix schek b'ojok winhaj Jeroboam chi', yik tz'och he diosalok, yuj juntzanh chi' ol eyak' ganar he na'ani.

Ix he pechpaxel heb' sacerdote yik Jehová, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón yet' heb' levita. Ix he komon sik'anoch heb' sacerdote icha sb'eyb'al juntzanhxo ch'ok nacional. Yalnhej mach sjawi yet' junok nok' kelem wakax yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, a jun chi' tz'ochkan sacerdote'al t'a juntzanh he diosal manh diosok chi'.
Palta a onhxo tik, malaj b'aj ix kaktejkan Jehová ko Diosal. Ha heb' sacerdote ayoch yak' serwil Jehová t'a ko kal, haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón yet' juntzanhxo heb' levita skolwaj yet' heb'.

Haton heb' chi' snhusantz'a silab' yet' incienso t'a Jehová t'a junjun k'inhib'alil yet' t'a junjun yemk'uhalil. Syak'anpaxem ixim pan heb' te wach' t'a sat mexa ayoch oro t'ay t'a yichanh Jehová, syak'anpaxoch sk'ak'al candil heb' nab'a oro t'a junjun yemk'uhalil. Ha onh tik sko k'anab'ajej wal icha tas syal Jehová ko Diosal, palta a exxo tik, ix eyik'el he b'a t'ay.

Ha Dios ayoch ket'ok, a heb' sacerdote, listaxo yaj heb' spu'an k'e'en strompeta yik skak'an owal heyet'ok. Ex wetisraelal, manh eyak' owal yet' Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham, yujto manh ol eyak'laj ganar, xchi winhaj Abías chi' t'a heb'.
Palta haxo winhaj Jeroboam, toxo ix yal winh t'a nanhal heb' soldado to ha t'a spatik heb' soldado yik Judá skot heb', haxo nanhalxo heb' skan t'a yichanh heb' yik Judá chi'.
Haxo ix yilanb'at heb' yik Judá chi' to wanxo sjawi heb' soldado t'a spatik heb' yet' t'a yichanh heb', yuj chi' ix tewi heb' t'a Jehová, ix spu'an k'e'en strompeta heb' sacerdote.
Ayik ix el yaw heb' yik Judá chi' yik owal, haxo Dios ix ak'an och winhaj Jeroboam chi' yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Abías sreyal Judá chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yel lemnaj heb' israel t'a heb' yik Judá chi'.
Ha winhaj Abías chi' yet' heb' soldado, te niwan anima ix smilcham heb'. 500 mil soldado yik Israel sik'b'il yajel ix chami.

Yuj chi' emnakilxonhej ix yutej sb'a heb' israel t'a jun pekti' chi'. Haxo heb' yik Judá chi', ix yak' ganar heb' t'a yib'anh heb', yujto ix yak'och Jehová heb' yipok sk'o'ol, haton sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham.
Ix b'at heb' soldado winhaj Abías chi' t'a spatik heb' yik winhaj Jeroboam chi', ix yik'ankanek' juntzanh schonhab' winhaj Jeroboam chi' heb', haton Betel, Jesana yet' Efraín yet' yaldea'il junjun.
Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi', majxo yik'laj yip yopisio winh chi' yakb'an pitzan winhaj Abías chi'. Haxo Jehová ix ik'anel sk'inal winhaj Jeroboam chi', ix cham winh.
Ix yik' wal yip yopisio winhaj Abías chi'. 14 heb' ix yetb'eyum winh, 22 heb' yuninal winh yet' 16 heb' ix yisil.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Abías chi' yet' tastak sk'ulejnak winh, aykan t'a yumal ix stz'ib'ejkan winhaj Iddo schekab' Dios.

Ayik ix cham winhaj Abías chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winh yuninal winh skuch Asa ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok t'a Judá. Ayik ayoch winhaj Asa chi' reyal, lajunhe' ab'il manhxa owal ix yak'a'.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Asa chi', wach'nhej, te tojol t'a yichanh Jehová Dios.

Yujto ix schek winh ik'chajel masanil altar yik skomon diosal heb' ch'ok nacional yet' juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh. Ix schekan winh mak'chajpoj juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en ay yelk'och t'a heb', ix schekan winh mak'chajpoj te' yechel Asera.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en to syak' wal och sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham. Yowalil sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il Jehová chi' heb'.
Hanhejtona' ix schekan winh ik'chajel juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Ayik ayoch winhaj Asa chi' reyal, malajnhej owal.
Ha Jehová ix ak'an junk'olal t'a skal heb', malaj b'aj ix yak' owal heb', yuj chi' ix schek winhaj Asa chi' b'ochajk'e juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi', ix laj och smuro'al.

Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' anima icha tik: Ko b'o'ekk'e juntzanh chonhab' tik, tz'ochpax smuro'al t'a spatiktak. Sko b'o'anpax b'aj stanhwej heb' soldado t'a yib'anh smuro'al chi' yet' spuerta'il tzek' k'atan k'e'en hierro syamnub'ok, yujto ayek' ko chonhab' tik t'a yol ko k'ab'. Icha chi' yaji yujto sko k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal. A' ix ak'an junk'olal t'a ko kal yet' masanil heb' ay t'a ko lak'anil tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' te wach' ix aj sb'o'elk'och munlajel chi'.

Ha winhaj Asa chi', ay 300 mil soldado winh, yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb' winh yet' pax slanza heb' winh. Ay pax 280 mil heb' winh yinhtilal Benjamín, yet'nak pax smaklab' jul-lab' heb' winh yet' sjul-lab'. Masanil heb' winh soldado chi', te jelan heb' winh.
Ix kot winhaj Zera sreyal Etiopía yet' jun millón soldado yet' 300 carruaje yik owal, ix jawi heb' t'a Maresa.
Ix b'at winhaj rey Asa chi', ix schalan sb'a winh yet' heb' t'a lum panhan yik Sefata t'a slak'anil Maresa chi'. Hata' ix k'och winh yak' owal yet' winhaj Zera chi'.

Ix tewi winhaj Asa chi' t'a Jehová Dios icha tik: Mamin Jehová, a ach tik lajannhej tz'aj a kolwaj t'a heb' niwan sb'isul yet' t'a heb' jaywannhej. Yuj chi' Mamin, kolwajanh ket'ok yujto tzach kak'och yipok ko k'o'ol. Yuj chi' wal t'a a b'i tzonh jawi kak' owal yet' juntzanh soldado tik. Ha ach tik, ko Diosal ach, ch'oxeli to malaj mach syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a ichanh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix kolwaj Jehová chi' yet' winh yet' heb' aj Judá. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' etíope chi' yuj heb', ix el lemnaj heb' t'a heb'.

Ix b'at winhaj Asa chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a spatik heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Gerar. Ix ak'ji ganar masanil heb' etíope chi', manhxa junok heb' ix kani, majxo yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' t'a heb' soldado. Pilan ix yik'ek' masanil tastak yet'nak heb' ajk'ol heb' soldado winhaj Asa chi'.

Ix yak'anpax owal winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil Gerar chi'. Ix yak' ganar juntzanh chonhab' chi' winh, yujto ix och jun xiwk'olal t'a heb' yuj Jehová. Ix yak' ganar masanil juntzanh chonhab' chi' heb' aj Judá chi'. Jantak b'eyumal ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix yik'nhejkot heb'.
Ix och pax heb' b'aj molan nok' molb'etzal nok', jantak nok' kalnel yet' nok' camello ix yik'kot heb' ayik ix meltzaj heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Ha jun winh skuchan Azarías yuninal winhaj Obed, ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winh,

ix elta winh scha' winhaj Asa chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh: Mamin Asa, ab' tas ol wal t'ayach yet' t'a he masanil ex wetchonhab' aj Judá yet' ex yinhtilal Benjamín: Ha Jehová ayoch ket'ok tato ayonh och tzak'an yuj. Tato anhej t'ay tzonh tewi, ol tak'woknhej t'ayonh, palta tato ol kaktejkan jun, ol onh yaktejpaxkani.
Niwanxo tiempo to manhxo'ok Dios te yel ayoch ket'ok, manhxa heb' sacerdote tz'ak'an k'ayb'ub'al, manhxa ley.
Haxo ix jawi yahelal t'a kib'anh, ix kak'anxi'och ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová ko Diosal, ix onh skolanxi.
Ayik mantzak kak'och ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' chi', manhxalaj junok mach junk'olal sb'eyek'i, yujto te niwan yahelal ayoch t'a yib'anh masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ay heb' anima ix laj satlajel sb'a, ay pax juntzanh chonhab' ix satanel juntzanhxo chonhab', yujto ha Dios ix ak'an somchaj heb' yuj juntzanh niwak yahelal chi'.
Palta a ex tik, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, manh eyak' chab'ax he k'o'ol, yujto a Jehová ol paktzitan he munlajel tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Asa tas ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi', ix stek'b'an wal sb'a winh. Ix schekan winh ik'chajel masanil juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak t'a yichanh Jehová ay t'a yol smakb'en Judá, t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' t'a yoltak juntzanh chonhab' ix yik'ek' winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Ix schekan winh b'ochajxi jun altar ay t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an masanil anima winh, heb' ay t'a yol yik Judá chi', t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo heb' kotnak t'a yol yik Efraín, t'a yol yik Manasés yet' t'a yol yik Simeón, haton heb' jawinak kajan t'a skal heb', yujto tzijtum heb' kajan t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Jeroboam ix jawi kajan t'a yol smakb'en Judá yujto ix yil heb' to ayoch Jehová Dios yet' winhaj Asa chi'.
Haxo t'a yoxil ujal yik 15 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa chi' reyal, ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak' silab' heb' t'a Jehová. 700 nok' wakax yet' 7 mil nok' kalnel ix yak' heb'. Haton nok' chi' ix yik'kanek' heb' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol t'a owal.
Hata' ix yak' sti' heb' to anhej Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham, ol yak' serwil heb' yet' smasanil sk'o'ol.
Ix yak' pax sti' heb', tato ay mach to manhok Jehová Dios syak' serwil, wach'chom icham anima, ma unin, winak, ma ix, yowalil schami.
Ix el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ix yak'an sti' heb' t'a Jehová, ix spu'an k'e'en strompeta heb' yet' nok' ch'a'ak.

Masanil heb' ay t'a smakb'en Judá chi' ix tzalaj wal heb' yuj b'aj ix yak' sti' chi' t'a smasanil sk'o'ol, ix el wal t'a sk'ol heb' yak'an serwil Jehová. Yuj chi' ix kolwaj Jehová chi' yet' heb', junk'olal ix aj heb' yet' masanil chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil.

Hanhejtona', ix yik'anel yopisio ix Maaca winhaj Asa chi', haton ix snun chichim winh, yujto ix schek ix b'ojok jun yechel Asera te yajb'entak t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha winhaj Asa chi' ix chekan mak'jipoj jun yechel chi', chok' ix aji. Ix schekan winh nhusjitz'a t'a sti' ha' Cedrón.
Wach'chom maj yik'el juntzanh lugar winh yik ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh t'a Israel, palta k'anab'ajumnhej ix yutej sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ix yak'anoch masanil k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata winh t'a yol templo, haton k'e'en ak'b'il t'a Jehová yuj winh yet' smam.
Malajnhej owal ix ochi, masanto yik 35 ab'ilxo yoch winh reyal.

Ayik 36 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal, ix kot winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel yak' owal t'a Judá. Ix scha'anel yich winhaj Baasa chi' sb'o'anoch smuro'al chonhab' Ramá yik smakan b'e winh yik manhxa mach sk'och t'a yol yik Judá chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'elta masanil k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata winhaj rey Asa chi' t'a stemplo Jehová yet' k'e'en ay t'a spalacio winh, ix yak'anb'at k'e'en winh t'a winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria kajan t'a Damasco. Ix yalanb'at winh icha tik:

Ko b'o junok ko trato, icha yutejnak sb'a heb' winh ko mam. Tik swak'b'at k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata t'ayach. Ak' lajwok a trato yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel, yik wach' tz'och wa'an winh yak'an owal t'ayin, xchib'at winhaj Asa chi'.

Ix scha sk'ol winhaj Ben-adad tas ix yal winhaj rey Asa chi', yuj chi' ix schekankot juntzanh heb' soldado winh yet' heb' yajalil yik skot heb' yak' owal t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik Israel. Ix yak'an ganar chonhab' Ijón heb', chonhab' Dan, chonhab' Abel-na'im yet' juntzanh chonhab' b'aj sik'chajkan ixim trigo t'a yol yik Neftalí.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Baasa chi', ix yaktan winh sb'o'ank'e Ramá chi' yuj skolan schonhab'.

Ix yik'anb'at masanil anima winhaj rey Asa chi', haton heb' ay t'a yol yik Judá, ix b'at yik'ankot k'e'en k'e'en heb' yet' te te' toxo ix smolb'ej winhaj Baasa b'aj wan sb'o'ank'e Ramá chi'. Haxo yet' juntzanh chi' ix sb'ok'e smuro'al chonhab' Geba yet' chonhab' Mizpa heb'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Hanani t'a winhaj rey Asa chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha heb' soldado yik Siria ix ak'och yipok a k'o'ol, manhok Jehová, yuj chi' toxo ix el heb' t'a yol a k'ab'.

¿Tom maxtzak a nakoti ayik yak'annak owal heb' aj Etiopía yet' heb' aj Libia het'ok? Manhxo jantakok heb' soldado, nok' chej yet' jantak carruaje yik owal yet'nak heb', palta ak'nak ganar heb' yuj Jehová, yujto a ak'nakoch yipok a k'o'ol.

Yujto a Jehová syilnhej masanil tas tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, sch'oxan spoder t'a heb' tojol syutej spensar t'ay, tato syak'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol sik'lab'il. Haxo tikne'ik, a jun tas ix a k'ulej tik, lajan wal icha sk'ulej junok anima malaj spensar. Yuj chi', a tikne'ik yet' ol b'eynhej tiempo, aynhej heb' ol ak'an owal het'ok, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh.

Ix kot yowal winhaj rey Asa chi' sik'lab'il t'a winh schekab' Dios chi', ix schekan winh ak'chajoch winh t'a preso. Hanheja' t'a jun pekti' chi', tzijtum heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix ak'ji'och syahelal yuj winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Asa, ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Judá yet' heb' sreyal Israel.

Ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winh reyal, ix och jun ilya te ow t'a yok winh, palta maj sna sb'a sk'ol winh yuj jun yahelal chi', manhok t'a Jehová ix yal sb'a winh, palta to ha t'a heb' anhtum b'aj ix b'at winh.
Ayik ix tz'akwi 41 ab'il yoch winh reyal, ix cham winh.

Ix mukji winh b'aj ix schek b'ojok yet'tal t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Niwan perfume ix yak'och heb' t'a yib'anh b'aj ix b'akhchaj sniwanil winh, ix och pax masanil makanhil tas suk'uk'i sjab' t'a winh, haton tas te wach' yaj sb'o'i. Ix yak'anoch jun niwan k'ak' heb' yik sch'oxanel heb' to niwan yelk'och winh t'a sat heb'.
Haxo winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Asa chi' ix och reyal. Ix stek'b'ej sb'a winh t'a yichanh Israel.

Ix yak'och heb' soldado winh t'a juntzanh chonhab' ayoch smuro'al t'a yol yik Judá. Ix aj heb' soldado t'a masanil yol smakb'en Judá chi' yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Efraín, haton juntzanh yik'nakkanek' winhaj Asa smam winh.
Ix och wal Jehová yet' winhaj Josafat chi', yujto a tas sb'eyb'alejnak winhaj David smam yicham winh t'a sb'ab'elal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Maj yak'laj serwil juntzanh yechel Baal winh,
palta to a Jehová sDiosal smam yicham winh ix yak' serwil, ix sk'anab'ajej wal scheknab'il Dios chi' winh. Manhok sb'eyb'al heb' ay t'a chonhab' Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Yuj chi' a Jehová ix ak'an wal tek'k'aj winh t'a yopisio chi'. Masanil heb' aj Judá chi', ix si'ej tastak heb' t'a winh, yuj chi' ix te k'echa'anh sb'eyumal winh, te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh.
Ix yak' wal och winh t'a sk'ol sb'eyb'alan sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová, ix schekan winh ik'chajel juntzanh yik ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh yet' masanil juntzanh yechel Asera t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi'.

Ayik yoxil ab'ilxo yoch winh reyal chi', ix schekanb'at juntzanh heb' winh sat yajal winh: Haton winhaj Ben-hail, winhaj Abdías, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Natanael yet' winhaj Micaías yik sk'ayb'aj masanil heb' anima yuj heb' winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi'.

Ix b'atpax juntzanh heb' winh levita tik yet' heb' winh: Haton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Netanías, winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Asael, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Adonías, winhaj Tobías yet' winhaj Tobadonías, yet' pax heb' winh sacerdote, haton winhaj Elisama yet' winhaj Joram.
Ix chekjib'at heb' winh yet' ch'anh yumal sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová, yik sb'at k'ayb'aj heb' anima t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi' yuj heb' winh.
Yuj chi', masanil anima t'a juntzanh nación t'a slak'anil Judá chi', ix xiw heb' t'a Jehová, majxo stek'b'ej sb'a heb' yak'an owal yet' winhaj Josafat chi'.

Haxo ix aji, ay heb' filisteo ix ik'ankot tas yik si'ej heb' t'a winhaj Josafat chi', ix yik'paxkot k'e'en plata heb', icha k'e'en tumin tz'ak'ji'och t'a yib'anh heb' yak'ani. Yet' pax heb' árabe, ix yik'kot 7 mil 700 nok' ch'ak kalnel heb', icha pax chi' sb'isul nok' chiwa ix yik'kot heb'.

Icha wal chi' ix aj yik'an yip yopisio winhaj Josafat chi'. Ix schekan winh b'ochajk'e juntzanh chonhab' tz'och smuro'al t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi' yet' juntzanh chonhab' b'aj sik'chajkan tastak swaji.
Manh jantakok tas swaji sik'an yuj winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en Judá chi', ay pax heb' soldado te jelan ayek' t'a Jerusalén.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado tik icha syal yinhtilal heb' winh: Ha winhaj Adnas yajal yaj t'a 300 mil soldado te jelan t'a yinhtilal Judá.
Haxo winhaj Johanán yajal yaj t'a 280 mil soldado.
Haxo winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Zicri, ix el wal t'a sk'ol winh yak'anoch sb'a yak'an serwil Jehová, a winh yajal yaj t'a 200 mil soldado te jelan.
Haxo winhaj Eliada yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado yinhtilal Benjamín, haton heb' te jelan t'a owal, 200 mil sb'isul heb', yet'nak sjul-lab' heb' yet' maklab' jul-lab' chi'.
Haxo winhaj Jozabad yajal yaj t'a 180 mil soldado lista yaj yet' syamk'ab' yik owal.
Masanil heb' tik ayoch heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh rey chi'. Manh ayok ochlaj heb' ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' ayoch smuro'al t'a yol yik Judá stz'akub'ok heb' tik.
Ha winhaj Josafat chi', ix te aj sb'eyumal winh, ix te b'inaj winh. Haxo ix yisil winhaj Acab sreyal Israel ix och yalib'ok winh.

Ix ek' jaye' ab'il, ix b'at winh t'a Samaria yil winhaj Acab chi'. Tzijtum nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax ix schek winhaj Acab chi' miljokchamok yik tz'och k'inh yujto ix k'och winhaj Josafat yet' heb' ajun yet'ok. Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winh to tz'och winh yet' winh yik syak'an owal winh yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --¿Mamax yal a k'ol tzach och wet'ok yik skak'an owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha in tik ol in b'at het'ok yet' masanil heb' winh in soldado t'a owal chi'.
Palta ayik manto onh b'ati, ko k'anb'ej tas xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix schek winh sreyal Israel chi' molb'aj masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, 400 sb'isul heb' winh smasanil. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tzam kak' owal t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, ma to ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ak' owal chi', yujto ha Dios ol ak'anoch t'a yol a k'ab', xchi heb' winh.
Palta ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --¿Mama junok winh schekab' Jehová t'a tik yik sko k'anb'ej pax t'a winh? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ay jun winh t'a tik, syal sk'anb'an winh t'a Jehová ku'uj, haton winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla. Palta tzin chak wal jun winak chi', yujto malaj junelok ay jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'ayin, chuknhej tas syal winh, xchi winh. Palta ix yalanxi winhaj Josafat chi': --Manh al jun chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot jun winh schekab' winh sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --B'at awtejkot winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla t'a elanhchamel, xchi winh.

Ha heb' winh rey chi' schawanhil, ayoch spichul heb' winh yik sreyal yuj, k'ojanem heb' winh t'a sk'ojnub' b'aj tz'ochk'och anima t'a yol chonhab' Samaria. Ayek' masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Quenaana, ay juntzanh k'e'en icha nok' ch'a'ak ix sb'o winh, te cha'anh ix yal winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha yet' juntzanh ch'a'ak tik ol ak' owal yet' heb' sirio, masanto ol lajwokel heb' smasanil, xchi winh t'a winhaj Acab chi'.

Ix yalanpax masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a chekab'ok Dios chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ochanh ak' owal yet' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad chi', ol ak' ganar, yujto a Jehová ol ak'anoch t'a yol a k'ab', xchi heb' winh.

Ha winh chekab' ix b'at awtankot winhaj Micaías chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Masanil heb' winh schekab' Dios, wach'nhej ix yutej heb' winh yalan t'a winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' swal t'ayach, icha ix yutej heb' winh yalan chi', icha pax chi' tzutej halani, wach'nhej ol utej halani, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Swak' in ti' t'a Jehová to anhej tas ol yal t'ayin, ha' ol wala', xchi winh.

Ix k'och winhaj Micaías chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Micaías ¿tzam yal kak'an owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, mato ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix stz'akan yal winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Ixik ak' owal chi', ol ak' ganar, yujto ol ak'chajoch jun chonhab' chi' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi winh.
Palta ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Tzijtum elxo ix wal t'ayach to tzak' a ti' to anhej tas yel tzal t'ayin t'a sb'i Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: Ix wil masanil heb' soldado israel, toxonhej sakleminak ix ajkanb'at heb' t'a jolomtak witz icha nok' kalnel manhxalaj stanhwumal. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha juntzanh anima tik, manhxalaj yajalil heb', junk'olalokab' smeltzaj junjun heb' t'a spat, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --Inaton wal swal t'ayach, to a jun winak tik malaj b'aj syal jab'ok tas wach' winh t'ayin, te chuknhej tas syal winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Ab' wal tas syal Jehová t'ayach: Ix wila' k'ojanem Jehová t'a sdespacho, masanil heb' ángel t'a satcha'anh linhjab'och t'a spatik yichanh.

Ix sk'anb'an Jehová chi' icha tik: ¿Mach sb'at iptzitan winhaj Acab sreyal Israel, yik sb'at yak'an owal winh yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, yik schamkan winh ta'? xchi Jehová chi'. Ch'ok tas syal juntzanh heb', ch'ok pax tas syal juntzanhxo heb'.
Palta ay jun espíritu ix och t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yalan icha tik: Ol in b'at wak' sk'ulej winh rey chi', xchi. Ix sk'anb'an Jehová chi' t'ay tas ol yutej.

Ix yalan icha tik: Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a a chekab'ok, ol wak' yak' es heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', xchi. Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'ay icha tik: Ol yal uj icha chi', ixik, b'at k'ulej icha tzal chi', xchi t'ay.

Ha tikne'ik jun, ojtakejeli to a Jehová ix cha'an sk'ulej heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok tik yik junnhej syutej heb' winh yak'an es t'ayach, icha chi' ol aj skotkan chamel t'a ib'anh, xchi winhaj Micaías chi'.

Yuj chi' ix snitzankot sb'a winhaj Sedequías chi' ix stz'itanb'at sat winhaj Micaías chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha jun espíritu tz'esan ix kot t'a Jehová chi', ¿tas ix aj yel t'ayin, haxo t'ayach sloloni? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ol a nakot jun tik t'a jun k'u chi', haton yik toxonhej ol ach ek' tik ol ach ek' tik a say b'aj ol a k'ub'ejel a b'a, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --Yamec winhaj Micaías tik, tzeyik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Amón yajal t'a chonhab' tik yet' t'a winh wuninal aj Joás.
Tzeyalani to a in swala' to tz'och winh t'a preso, jab'nhej tas tzeyak' swa winh yet' tas syuk'ej winh, masanto ayik ol in meltzaj t'a tzalajk'olal, xchi winh.

Ixto yal jay b'elanhxo winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: Tato wach' tz'aj a meltzaji, syalelk'ochi to manhok Jehová tz'alan t'ayin syal chi', xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh: E masanil ex chonhab', na'anhejokab' eyu'uj tas ix wal tik, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winh sreyal Israel chi' yet' heb' soldado yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad chi'.

Ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --Ayik ol ko yamanoch owal chi', ol in k'exel in pichul yik in reyal tik, a hachxo tik, ol ak'nhejkanoch a pichul yik a reyal chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix sk'exel spichul winh sreyal Israel chi', ix och heb' winh yak' owal chi' schawanhil.
Palta a winh sreyal Siria, toxo ix yal winh t'a heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a carruaje yik owal to max yak' owal heb' winh yet' junokxo mach, palta anhej t'a winh sreyal Israel b'aj tz'och heb' winh.

Ayik ix ilji winhaj Josafat yuj heb' winh sat yajal yaj chi', a sna'an heb' winh to a winh sreyal Israel chi', yuj chi' ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatik winh, yik syak'an owal heb' winh yet' winh yalani. Yuj chi', ix el yaw winh, ix kolji winh yuj Jehová, ix ik'ji'el heb' winh yajal chi' yuj Jehová t'a winh.
Haxo ix yilan heb' winh to manhoklaj winh sreyal Israel chi', ix yaktan heb' winh syaman winh.

Palta ay jun winh soldado komonnhej ix julwajb'ati, a wal t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' ix och sirnaj jun yol jul-lab' chi'. Ha wal b'aj schalaj sb'a sk'e'en pichul winh rey chi' ayochi, hata' ix och ch'apnaj jun yol jul-lab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh et'jinak carruaje chi' icha tik: --Ik' meltzaj carruaje tik, tzin ik'anel t'a skal owal tik, yujto te niwan ix in aj in lajwi, xchi winh.

Te ow ix aj yoch owal t'a jun k'u chi', ixto stek'b'ej sb'a winh sreyal Israel chi' skan tek'tek' t'a yol scarruaje ayik ayoch winh t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi', masanto yik ix em k'u. Palta haxo yik wan sb'at pilnaj k'u, ix cham winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Josafat chi' t'a spalacio t'a Jerusalén.

Ix elta winhaj Jehú schekab' Dios yuninal winhaj Hanani scha winh rey chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿Tas yuj ix ach kolwaj yet' jun winh chuk spensar chi'? ¿Tas yuj wach' ak'an yet' jun winh ayoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová? Yuj chi' toxo ix kot yowal Jehová t'ayach.
Palta jun, ayto wal juntzanhxo tas wach' yoch a wach'ilok, yujto ix a satel yechel Asera t'a yol a makb'en tik, ix ak'anpaxoch t'a a k'ol ak'an serwil Dios, xchi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh.

Ha t'a Jerusalén kajan winhaj Josafat chi', palta ay jun smodo winh, to sb'at winh yil juntzanhxo schonhab', schakot winh t'a Beerseba, masanto sk'ek'och winh t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Tz'ek' winh yik syak'xi'och sb'a heb' anima t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham.
Ix ak'ji'och heb' winh juez yuj winh t'a junjun chonhab' ayoch smuro'al ay t'a yol yik Judá chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh juez chi' icha tik: Scham wal eyilan tas ol he k'ulej, yujto manhok tas snib'ej heb' anima ol he k'ulej, palta to a wal tas snib'ej Jehová. Ol ochnhej Jehová chi' heyet'ok yik tze b'o'an yaj yowal heb' anima.

Yuj chi', niwanokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a he sat, scham wal eyilan tas ol he k'ulej, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal, manh ol techaj yuj tato ay tas manh wach'ok ol he k'ulej, tato ay sk'exanhil anima t'a yol he sat, mato ol he cha k'e'en tumin t'a elk'altak, xchi winh.

Hanhejtona' ix sik'anpaxelta juntzanh heb' winh levita winh, heb' winh sacerdote yet' juntzanh heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', yik tz'och heb' winh juezal yik sk'ayb'aj heb' anima chi' yuj heb' winh t'a sley Jehová yet' yik sb'o'an yaj yowal heb' anima chi' heb' winh t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ix yak'ankan juntzanh cheknab'il tik winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha ex tik, ol eyil eyopisio tik, ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a he sat, tze k'anab'ajani, wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a.

Yalnhej tas yaj yowal heb' ketchonhab' tik, ol jawok heb' t'ayex, ma yuj heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', tato ha' yuj junok lolonel, ma yuj mak'ojcham anima, ma juntzanhxo tas tz'el sk'ulan heb' to manh icha'ok yalan sley Jehová, tze b'o yaj t'a heb'. Scham wal he kachan heb' yik max och smul heb' t'a Jehová, yik max kot yowal t'a eyib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb'. Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yik manh ol och he mul.

Ha winhaj Amarías sat sacerdote yaji, anhej winh syal yalani tas ol aj sb'o tastak yik Jehová. Haxo winhaj Zebadías yuninal winhaj Ismael, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá, anhej winh syal yalan tas ol aj pax yik winh rey yaji. Ol kolwaj pax heb' winh levita heyet'ok. Tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, ak'ek eyip t'a eyopisio tik. Ha mach wach'nhej tas ol sk'ulej, ol ochnhej Jehová yet'ok, xchi winh.
Ix ek' jun pekti', a heb' moabita yet' heb' amonita, junnhej ix yutej sb'a heb' yet' heb' me'unita yik syak'an owal heb' yet' Judá.

Yuj chi' ix jawi jaywanh winak yal t'a winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá icha tik: Ha t'a Edom yet' t'a junxo sk'axepal ha' mar Muerto, wan skot jantak soldado t'ayach. Ayxo'ek' heb' t'a chonhab' Hazezon-tamar, xchi heb' winh. (Ha jun chonhab' chi' skuchan pax En-gadi.)
Ix te xiw winhaj Josafat chi', ix sna'an winh to syak'och sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yuj chi' ix yal winh to masanil anima t'a yol yik Judá tz'och t'a tzek'ojk'olal.
Ix kot masanil anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi' yik sk'anan skolwal Jehová heb' yet' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e linhan winhaj Josafat chi' t'a skal masanil heb' anima molanek' t'a Jerusalén chi', t'a yichanh jun ak' yamak'il stemplo Jehová.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach Jehová, ko Diosal ach yet' heb' ko mam kicham, a ach tik sDiosal ach satcha'anh, Yajal ach pax t'a yib'anh masanil chonhab'. Te niwan a poder, malaj junok mach syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a ichanh.

Ach ko Diosal, a ach ik'nakel juntzanh anima kajan t'a sat lu'um tik, haton b'aj ayonh ek' a onh a chonhab' Israel onh tik. Ak'annakkan lum t'a junelnhej t'ayonh a onh yinhtil onh kan winhaj Abraham tik, haton winh a wach'k'o'ol.
Ayik kajnajnakxo heb' ko mam kicham t'a tik, sb'o'annakk'e jun templo heb' to ik yaji, yalannak heb' icha tik:

Tato sjawi junok yahelal t'a kib'anh ma junok owal sjawi yuj ko chukal, ma ilya, ma wejel, ol onh jawok t'a ichanh t'a a templo tik, yujto ayach ek' t'ay. Ha t'a skal ko yahelal chi' ol ko k'an a kolwal, ol ab'an tas ol ko k'ana', ol onh a kolani, xchi heb'.

Ha tikne'ik jun, ina yajek' heb' amonita, heb' moabita yet' heb' kajan t'a tzalkixtak yik Seir, haton lum slu'um heb' b'aj maj yal a k'ol ek'nakkot heb' ko mam kicham a onh israel onh tik ayik yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, to sk'exb'e'ejnak sb'a heb', maj satji'el-laj heb' anima chi' yuj heb'.
Haxo tikne'ik jun, a tas tz'aj spakan jun chi' heb' t'ayonh, to snib'ej heb' syak' owal ket'ok yik tzonh yik'el heb' t'a lum lum ak'nak ko makb'enej tik.

Ach ko Diosal, elok wal t'a a k'o'ol to tzak'och syahelal heb', yujto a onh tik malaj kip yik sko tek'b'an ko b'a t'a yichanh jantak heb' soldado wan sjawi yak' owal t'a tik. Manh kojtakok tas wal sko k'ulej, yuj chi' a t'ayach skak'och ko pensar, xchi winh rey chi' t'a Jehová.
Masanil heb' aj Judá, linhank'e heb' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' masanil yetb'eyum yet' yal yuninal heb', wach'chom heb' te kotakto.
Ay jun winh levita yinhtilal winhaj Asaf skuchan Jahaziel yuninal winhaj Zacarías, yixchikin winhaj Benaías yuninal winhaj Jeiel, yixchikin winhaj Matanías. Ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh,

yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ab'ek wal ex aj Judá, ex aj Jerusalén yet' ach rey Josafat. Xchi wal Jehová icha tik: Manh ex xiwok, manh eyek xiw he b'a t'a yichanh jantak soldado chi', yujto a jun owal chi', manh eyikok, palta wik a in Dios in tik.
