Tekan aykot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a kib'anh tikne'ik, yujto a heb' ko mam kicham maj sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal Jehová, maj sb'eyb'alej pax heb' tastak aykan t'a jun u'um tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Hilcías yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ix chekjib'at yuj winh rey chi', ix b'at heb' winh yil ix Hulda ix schekab' Dios, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Ticva, yixchikin winhaj Harhas. Ha winhaj Salum chi' sik'an masanil pichul t'a skajnub' Dios. kajan ix Hulda chi' t'a jun scha makanhil chonhab' t'a Jerusalén. Ayik ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix,
ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan icha tik: Alek t'a winh ix ex chekankot he k'anb'ej chi' t'ayin
to a in Jehová in tik swala': Ol wak'kot junok yahelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh masanil anima kajan t'ay, icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a jun u'um ix awtaj t'a ichanh chi'.

Yujto ix in eyaktejkani, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios tze nhus incienso. Tze tzuntzankot yowal in k'ol yuj masanil tas ix he k'ulej chi'. Yuj chi' toxo ix kot yowal in k'o'ol t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, maxtzak tuplaj.
Yuj chi' alek t'a winh sreyal Judá, winh ix ex chekankot ul he k'anb'ej t'ayin Jehová sDiosal in Israel tik to a in swal icha tik: Yujto ix a cha ab' tas syal jun u'um chi',

ix ak'an wal och t'a a k'o'ol, ix ak'anoch a b'a t'a yol in k'ab' ayik ix ab'ani to ay yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'ay, yujto ix ik'em a b'a t'a wichanh, ix a nhik'chitanb'at a pichul, ix ach ok'i, hanhejtona' in ix wab' pax tas ix ala'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swal t'ayach:

Ha in ol wak'elk'ochi to junk'olal ol ach chamok, ol ach mukchaj b'aj mukan heb' a mam icham. Ichato chi' ol jawok juntzanh yahelal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan t'ay, xchi Jehová, xchi ix Hulda chi'. Yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi', ix ul yalan spak tas ix b'at sk'anb'ej heb' winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan winh rey chi' awtajkot masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil Judá yet' heb' yik Jerusalén chi' to smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e winh rey chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová yet' masanil heb' ix smolb'ej sb'a chi' yet' pax heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh levita yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi' yet' pax masanil heb' unin yet' masanil heb' ichamtak anima. Hata' ix schek winh rey chi' awtaj jun u'um chi' yab' masanil anima chi', haton tastak aykan t'a yumal strato Jehová ix ilchajelta yuj heb' t'a yol templo chi'.

Ix och linhan winh rey chi' t'a stz'ey jun niwan oy. Hata' ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Jehová to t'a wal smasanil sk'o'ol winh ol sk'anab'ajej sb'eyb'alan masanil cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al chi', icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal strato Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima molanek' chi', heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' yik Benjamín to syak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajani. Masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal yajkan t'a yumal strato sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham.

Ix schekan winhaj Josías chi' ik'jokel masanil yechel yajb'entak ay t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi'. Ix yalan winh to tz'och masanil heb' ayek' t'a Israel chi' ejmelal t'a Jehová Dios. Yakb'an pitzanto winh, maj yik'el sb'a heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' smam yicham heb'.

Ix och k'inh yuj winhaj Josías chi' yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová winh t'a Jerusalén chi', haton yik sna'ankot heb' ayik yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Ayik 14 yoch b'ab'el uj ix smilcham nok' kalnel heb' silab'il yuj k'inh chi'.
Ix yak'anoch heb' winh sacerdote winh t'a yopisio, ix iptzitaj heb' winh yuj winh yik syilan yopisio heb' winh chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová.

Ix schekan winh smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh levita tz'ak'an serwil Jehová, haton heb' winh sk'ayb'an heb' yetisraelal. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Na'ekkoti to a te' skaxa'il strato Jehová, aykan te' t'a yol skajnub' Jehová sb'onak winhaj Salomón yuninal winhaj David sreyal Israel. Yuj chi' a ex tik maxtzak he b'akhlaj b'eyek' te' t'a sjolom he jenhjab'. Ha tikne'ik ak'ek serwil Jehová ko Diosal yet' pax heb' ketisraelal schonhab' ko Diosal chi'.
B'o'ekoch he b'a t'a stzolal, icha syal stzolal smakanhil heb' he mam eyicham, icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan yuj winhaj David yet' winhaj Salomón chi'.
Tzex kan nanhalok ex levita ex tik t'a skajnub' Jehová chi', icha syal smakanhil eyaji, yik wach' tzex kolwaj t'a junjun makan heb' ketisraelal sk'ab'yok sb'a,

yik tze milancham nok' kelemtak kalnel silab'il yik k'inh tik. Yuj chi' sakb'itejek he b'a icha yalan ley yet' pax tas yowalil sakb'itaji, yik wach' syal sk'anab'ajan heb' ketisraelal tik masanil tas yalnakkan winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo t'a skal nok' smolb'etzal nok' winhaj Josías chi' ix yik'elta juntzanh nok' ix yak' winh t'a heb' anima molanek' chi', yik wach' ay nok' syal yak'an heb' silab'il t'a k'inh chi'. Haton sb'isul nok' tik: 30 mil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa yet' 3 mil nok' kelemtak wakax.

Hanhejtona' heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh rey chi', ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol heb' winh yak'an silab' t'a heb' chonhab' chi', t'a heb' winh sacerdote yet' t'a heb' winh levita. Haxo pax winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Jehiel, haton heb' winh tz'ilan skajnub' Jehová, 2 mil 600 nok' kalnel yet' 300 nok' kelemtak wakax ix yak' heb' winh yik tz'och k'inh chi'.

Ha winhaj Conanías yet' heb' winh yuk'tak, haton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Jeiel yet' winhaj Josabad, haton heb' winh yajalil heb' winh levita, 5 mil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa ix yak' heb' winh yik tz'och k'inh chi'. Ix yak'anpax 500 nok' kelemtak wakax heb' winh yik syak' nok' heb' winh levita silab'il.
Ayik wach'xo yaj masanil yik tz'och k'inh chi', ix sb'o'anoch sb'a heb' winh sacerdote t'a stzolal yet' pax heb' winh levita, icha ix aj yalan winh rey.

Ix smilancham nok' nok' chi' heb' winh silab'il yik k'inh chi'. Ix yak'an schik'il nok' heb' winh levita chi' t'a heb' winh sacerdote. Haxo heb' winh ix tzikanoch schik'il nok' chi' t'a altar. Ixlajwi chi' ix spatz'anel nok' heb' winh levita chi'.

Ix spojanek' xepu'al nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix yak'an heb' winh t'a junjun makan heb' ayto yuj sb'a, yik syak'an heb' t'a Jehová, icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal yuj winhaj Moisés. Hanheja' icha chi' ix yutej pax nok' wakax heb' winh.

Ix sb'olan nok' silab' yik k'inh chi' heb' winh, icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkani. Haxo juntzanhxo nok' silab' chi', ix stz'anh nok' heb' winh t'a yol chen yet' t'a yoltak xalten. Elanhchamel ix spukek' nok' heb' winh t'a heb' anima.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'o'an yik heb' winh levita chi' yet' pax tas yik heb' winh sacerdote, yujto a heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal Aarón te ay tas sk'ulej heb' winh sk'e ak'wal yik snhusan nok' silab' heb' winh stz'a smasanil yet' pax xepu'al nok'. Yuj chi' munil ix sb'o yik heb' winh levita chi', ix sb'o'anpax yik heb' winh sacerdote chi' heb' winh.

Haxo pax heb' winh sb'itani, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf, ayoch heb' winh t'a yopisio chi', icha yajkan yuj winhaj rey David, winhaj Asaf, winhaj Hemán yet' winhaj Jedutún, schekab' heb' tik winhaj rey David chi'. Haxo heb' winh stanhwan puerta, aypaxoch heb' winh yilan yopisio chi'. Malaj junok heb' winh syaktejkan yilan yopisio, yujto a heb' winh yetlevita'il heb' winh sb'o'an nok' silab' heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji serwil Jehová t'a sk'uhal k'inh chi', yik tz'ak'jipax silab' t'ay t'a altar, haton silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil, icha ix aj yalan winhaj rey Josías chi'.
Masanil heb' israel wan sb'o'an k'inh chi', uke' k'uhal pax ix swa ixim pan heb' malaj yich.

Malaj b'aj ix och junok k'inh icha jun chi' yiktax t'a stiempo'al winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios. Malaj wal junokxo sreyal Israel ix ak'anoch jun k'inh chi' icha ix aj yoch yuj winhaj rey Josías yet' heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh levita yet' masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel ayek' chi' yet' pax heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal ix och jun k'inh chi'.

Ayik toxo ix laj uji juntzanh chi', ayik toxo ix b'ochajxi skajnub' Jehová yuj winhaj rey Josías chi', haxo winhaj Necao sreyal Egipto, wan sb'at winh t'a ha' Éufrates yik syak' owal winh yet' chonhab' Carquemis. Haxo winhaj rey Josías chi' ix b'at smak sat winh.

Ha winhaj Necao chi', ix schekkot heb' schekab' winh yik tzul alchaj t'a winhaj Josías chi' icha tik: Ach sreyal Judá, manh ak' owal wet'ok, yujto manhok het'ok tzin jawi wak' owal, palta a yet' junxo nación aytaxon wowal yet'ok, yujto ha Dios ix halan t'ayin to tzin pil wip wak'an owal tik. Aktej a telan a b'a yet' Dios yik wach' max ach satel yuj, yujto ha' ayoch wet'ok, xchikot winh.

Palta haxo winhaj Josías chi' maj meltzajlaj winh, to ix sk'exel sb'a winh yik syak'an owal winh. Maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal winhaj Necao chi', wach'chom ha Dios ix halani. Yuj chi' ix yak' owal winh yet' winhaj Necao chi' t'a jun panhan yik Meguido.

Ha heb' sjulwajum winhaj Necao chi', ix sjulb'at sjul-lab' heb' t'a winhaj Josías chi'. Ix yamchaj winh sjulan heb', yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' et'jinak scarruaje: Ik'ek in el t'a tik, yujto te niwan ix in aj in lajwi, xchi winh.

Ix yik'anelta winh heb', ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yol junxo schab'il carruaje, ix yik'ankot winh heb' t'a Jerusalén, hata' ix cham winh. Ix smukan winh heb' b'aj mukb'il heb' smam yicham. Masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén ix ok' heb' yuj winh.

Haxo winhaj Jeremías ixb'o'an jun sb'ital yik snachajkot schamel winh. Ix kannhej jun b'it chi', masanil heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'itani, ayik sb'itan jun b'it chi' heb' yuj schamel junok anima, snakot winhaj Josías chi' heb'. Ha jun b'it chi' ix ochkan t'a stzolal sb'itan heb' israel yuj junok chamel, aykan t'a yumal sb'ital kusk'olal.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josías chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, te wach' icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal sley Jehová
yet' masanil tastak ix sk'ulej winh ayik ix el yich yet' slajwub', aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel yet' Judá.
Ixlajwi chi' haxo masanil heb' anima ix ak'anoch winhaj Joacaz yuninal winhaj Josías chi' reyal t'a Jerusalén sk'exulok winh smam chi'.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 23 ab'il sk'inal winh, oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh.

Ha winh sreyal Egipto ix ik'anel winh t'a reyal chi'. Ix yak'anoch k'e'en tumin winh sreyal Egipto chi' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá chi' yik syak'an 75 quintal k'e'en plata heb' yet' oxe' arroba k'e'en oro.

Haxo winhaj Eliaquim yuk'tak winhaj Joacaz chi' ix ochkan reyal t'a Judá chi' yuj winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ix k'exchaj sb'i winhaj Eliaquim chi' yuj winh, Joacim ix sb'i'ejkan winh, haxo winhaj Joacaz chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winh sreyal Egipto chi'.
Ayik ix och winhaj Joacim chi' reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová Dios.
Haxo winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia ix jawi yak' owal yet' winh, ix tzek'ji winh t'a k'e'en cadena, ix ik'jib'at winh t'a Babilonia chi'.
Hanhejtona' ix yik'b'at juntzanh yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a yol stemplo sdiosal t'a Babilonia chi'.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joacim chi' yet' tastak te yajb'entak ix sk'ulej winh yet' juntzanhxo chukal ix sk'ulej winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Israel yet' heb' yik Judá. Haxo winhaj Joaquín yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joaquín yak'an reyal, 18 ab'il sk'inal winh. Oxe' ujal yet' lajunhexo k'uhal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha t'a b'ab'el uj yik jun ab'il chi', ix yal winhaj Nabucodonosor to tz'ik'jib'at winhaj Joaquín chi' t'a Babilonia yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' te caro stojol ay t'a skajnub' Jehová. Haxo winhaj Sedequías ix ak'ji'och reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén sk'exulok winhaj Joaquín chi'. Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', sk'ab' yok sb'a winh yet' winhaj Joaquín chi'.
Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', 21 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Maj sna sb'a sk'o'ol winh yuj skachnab'il ix schek Jehová yal winh schekab' aj Jeremías.

Ijan ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor yalani, haton b'aj ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Dios to junnhej ix yutej spensar winh yet' winh. Junelnhej ix yak' pitb'okel spensar winh, majxo yal sk'o'ol winh ix meltzaj t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Hanhejtona' masanil heb' winh yajal t'a Judá chi', heb' winh sacerdote yet' masanil heb' anima, ix te k'e wal cha'anh heb' sk'ulan chukal te yajb'entak. Ha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il ix sb'eyb'alej heb', ix yixtanel skajnub' Jehová heb', haton jun sik'b'ilel yuj t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' smam yicham heb', ix scheknhejkot heb' schekab' yik tzul kachji heb', yujto tz'ok' sk'ol t'a schonhab' yet' t'a skajnub' chi'.

Palta tonhej ix stzetzej heb' schekab' Dios chi' heb', malaj yelk'och tas ix yal heb' t'a sat heb'. Ix b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb' schekab' Dios chi', masanto ix em wal yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh schonhab' chi', majxo yal-laj yoch wa'an.

Ixlajwi chi', ix chekjikot winh sreyal heb' aj Babilonia chi' yuj Jehová, ix jawi winh yak' owal yet' heb' aj Judá chi'. Ix miljicham heb' kelemtak t'a k'e'en espada t'a yamak'il skajnub' Dios. Manhxa jab'ok sniwank'olal heb' t'a heb' kelemtak chi' yet' t'a heb' ix kob'estak, t'a heb' icham anima manhxa yip. Ix ak'ji'och heb' smasanil t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey chi' yuj Jehová.

Masanil yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Dios, niwak yet' kotak, jantaknhej tas ay t'a skajnub' chi' yet' masanil sb'eyumal winh rey yet' yik heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh rey chi', pilan ix yik'b'at winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Babilonia.
Ix snhusankantz'a skajnub' Dios chi' heb', ix smak'ankanem lanhnaj smuro'al Jerusalén chi' heb'. Ix snhusantz'a spalacio winh rey heb', ix smak'anpoj masanil tas caro stojol heb'.

Haxo heb' maj miljokcham t'a owal chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi'. Ix ochkan heb' chekab'ok t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal winh, masanto ayik ix ak'ji ganar Babilonia chi' yuj heb' aj Persia.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix schek Dios yal winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'an yip lum lum, yujto 70 ab'il manhxalaj mach ix munlaj t'a sat lu'um.

Ayik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, ix elk'och slolonel Jehová alb'ilkanel yuj winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Ha Jehová ix ak'an sna winhaj rey Ciro chi', yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun cheknab'il winh. Ix schekan winh alchajel t'a masanil yol smakb'en, ix schekanpax winh pukchaj u'um, syalan icha tik:

Ha in Ciro in tik sreyal in Persia, a in swal icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal satcha'anh, ha' ix ak'anoch masanil nación t'a sat lu'um tik t'a yol in k'ab'. A' ix halan t'ayin to tzin b'ok'e skajnub' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol yik Judá. Yuj chi', yalnhej mach ex schonhab' ex Jehová, kolwajokab' Jehová he Diosal chi' heyet'ok. Ha tikne'ik meltzajanhek t'a Jerusalén chi', xchi winh.
